194	// Command line options parsing
195	struct Options {
196	  bool help;
197	  float alpha, beta;
198	  int iterations;
199	  int m, n, k;
200	  Options():
201	    help(false),
202	    m(1024), n(1024), k(1024),
203	    alpha(1.f), beta(0.f),
204	    iterations(10)
205	  { }
206	  // Parses the command line
207	  void parse(int argc, char const **args) {
208	    cutlass::CommandLine cmd(argc, args);
209	    if (cmd.check_cmd_line_flag("help")) {
210	      help = true;
211	      return;
212	    }
213	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("m", m);
214	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("n", n);
215	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("k", k);
216	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("alpha", alpha, 1.f);
217	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("beta", beta, 0.f);
218	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("iterations", iterations);
219	  }
220	  /// Prints the usage statement.
221	  std::ostream & print_usage(std::ostream &out) const {
222	    out << "80b_blackwell_geforce_nvfp4_nvfp4_sparse_gemm\n\n"
223	      << "  Blackwell MXFP8 Sparse GEMM is a warp specialized kernel.\n\n"
224	      << "Options:\n\n"
225	      << "  --help                      If specified, displays this usage statement\n\n"
226	      << "  --m=<int>                   Sets the M extent of the GEMM\n"
227	      << "  --n=<int>                   Sets the N extent of the GEMM\n"
228	      << "  --k=<int>                   Sets the K extent of the GEMM\n"
229	      << "  --alpha=<f32>               Epilogue scalar alpha\n"
230	      << "  --beta=<f32>                Epilogue scalar beta\n\n"
231	      << "  --iterations=<int>          Number of profiling iterations to perform.\n\n";
232	    out << "\n\nExamples:\n\n"
233	      << "$ " << "./examples/80_blackwell_geforce_sparse_gemm/80b_blackwell_geforce_nvfp4_nvfp4_sparse_gemm" << " --m=1024 --n=512 --k=1024 --alpha=2 --beta=0.707 \n\n";
234	    return out;
235	  }
236	  /// Compute performance in GFLOP/s
237	  double gflops(double runtime_s) const
238	  {
239	    // Two flops per multiply-add
240	    uint64_t flop = uint64_t(2) * m * n * k;
241	    double gflop = double(flop) / double(1.0e9);
242	    return gflop / runtime_s;
243	  }
244	};
245	/// Result structure
246	struct Result
247	{
248	  double avg_runtime_ms;
249	  double gflops;
250	  cutlass::Status status;
251	  cudaError_t error;
252	  bool passed;
253	  Result(
254	    double avg_runtime_ms = 0,
255	    double gflops = 0,
256	    cutlass::Status status = cutlass::Status::kSuccess,
257	    cudaError_t error = cudaSuccess)
258	  :
259	    avg_runtime_ms(avg_runtime_ms), gflops(gflops), status(status), error(error), passed(false)
260	  {}
261	};
262	#if defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM120_SUPPORTED) || defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM121_SUPPORTED)
263	/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
264	/// GEMM setup and evaluation
265	/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
266	/// Helper to initialize a block of device data
267	template <typename Element, typename Layout>
268	bool initialize_block(
269	  cutlass::TensorView<Element, Layout> view,
270	  uint64_t seed) {
271	  double scope_max, scope_min;
272	  constexpr int bits_input = cutlass::sizeof_bits<Element>::value;
273	  if constexpr (bits_input == 1) {
274	    scope_max = 2;
275	    scope_min = 0;
276	  }
277	  else if constexpr (bits_input <= 6) {
278	    scope_max = 2;
279	    scope_min = -2;
280	  }
281	  else if constexpr (bits_input <= 8) {
282	    if constexpr (cute::is_same_v<Element, cutlass::float_ue8m0_t>) {
283	      scope_max = 4;
284	      scope_min = 1;
285	    }
286	    else {
287	      scope_max = 1;
288	      scope_min = -1;
289	    }
290	  }
291	  else{
292	    scope_max = 4;
293	    scope_min = -4;
294	  }
295	  cutlass::reference::host::TensorFillRandomUniform(
296	    view, seed, scope_max, scope_min, 0);
297	
298	  return true;
299	}
300	/// Initialize blocks that released to sparse Matrix A and its metadata E
301	bool initialize_sparse_blocks(const Options &options) {
302	  auto workload = make_shape(options.m,
303	                             options.n,
304	                             options.k,
305	                             1);
306	  stride_A = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, {options.m, options.k, 1});
307	  /// Alias SparseConfig and Compressor
308	  using SparseConfig = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::SparseConfig;
309	  using CompressorUtility = cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressorUtility<
310	                              cute::Shape<int, int, int, int>,
311	                              ElementA::DataType,
312	                              LayoutATag,
313	                              SparseConfig>;
314	  using CompressorKernel = cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressor<
315	                              cute::Shape<int, int, int, int>,
316	                              ElementA::DataType,
317	                              LayoutATag,
318	                              SparseConfig,
319	                              cutlass::arch::Sm120>;
320	  using Compressor = cutlass::transform::device::TransformUniversalAdapter<CompressorKernel>;
321	  /// Declare compressor_utility to randomly fill zero in Matrix A to match sparsity needs
322	  CompressorUtility compressor_utility(workload, stride_A);
323	  // Aligned M K dimension size for A and E
324	  int aligned_m_e = compressor_utility.get_metadata_m_physical();
325	  int aligned_k_e = compressor_utility.get_metadata_k_physical();
326	  int aligned_m_a = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_m_physical();
327	  int aligned_k_a = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_k_physical();
328	  /// Layout A and E
329	  layout_A = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(workload);
330	  layout_E = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(workload);
331	
332	  block_A.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(aligned_m_a * aligned_k_a));
333	  block_E.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(aligned_m_e * aligned_k_e));
334	  block_A_Decompressed.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(options.m * options.k));
335	  initialize_block(block_A_Decompressed.host_view(), seed + 2020);
336	  compressor_utility.structure_sparse_zero_mask_fill(
337	          block_A_Decompressed.host_data(), static_cast<int>(seed + 2021));
338	  block_A_Decompressed.sync_device();
339	
340	  /// Use compressor kernel to generate compressed Matrix A and E
341	  cutlass::Status status { cutlass::Status::kSuccess };
342	  cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo hw_info;
343	  hw_info.device_id = 0;
344	  hw_info.sm_count = cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo::query_device_multiprocessor_count(hw_info.device_id);
345	  typename Compressor::Arguments arguments{
346	    {options.m, options.n, options.k, 1},
347	    {block_A_Decompressed.device_data(),
348	      stride_A,
349	      block_A.device_data(),
350	      block_E.device_data()},
351	    {hw_info}
352	  };
353	
354	  // Compress A and E
355	  Compressor compressor_op;
356	  size_t workspace_size = Compressor::get_workspace_size(arguments);
357	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
358	  status = compressor_op.can_implement(arguments);
359	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
360	    return false;
361	  }
362	
363	  status = compressor_op.initialize(arguments, workspace.get());
364	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
365	    return false;
366	  }
367	
368	  status = compressor_op.run();
369	  auto result = cudaDeviceSynchronize();
370	  if (result != cudaSuccess) {
371	    return false;
372	  }
373	
374	  block_A.sync_host();
375	  block_E.sync_host();
376	  return true;
377	}
378	/// Initialize operands to be used in the GEMM and reference GEMM
379	bool initialize(const Options &options) {
380	  using namespace cute;
381	
382	  // Initial A, E(metadata) and A_compressed blocks
383	  if(!initialize_sparse_blocks(options)) return false;
384	
385	  // Define B, C and D blocks
386	  using Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig;
387	  stride_B = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideB{}, {options.n, options.k, 1});
388	  stride_C = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideC{}, {options.m, options.n, 1});
389	  stride_D = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideD{}, {options.m, options.n, 1});
390	  layout_B = make_layout(make_shape(options.n, options.k, 1), stride_B);
391	  layout_C = make_layout(make_shape(options.m, options.n, 1), stride_C);
392	  layout_D = make_layout(make_shape(options.m, options.n, 1), stride_D);
393	  layout_SFD = SfdOutputCfg::tile_atom_to_shape_SFD(cute::make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.k, 1));
394	  // Define SFA and SFB tensors layouts
395	  layout_SFA = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(cute::make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.k, 1));
396	  layout_SFB = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFB(cute::make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.k, 1));
397	  block_B.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_B)));
398	  block_C.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_C)));
399	  block_D.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_D)));
400	  block_SFD.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(filter_zeros(layout_SFD))));
401	  block_reference_D.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_D)));
402	  block_reference_SFD.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(filter_zeros(layout_SFD))));
403	  block_Normconst.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(1));
404	  block_SFA.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(filter_zeros(layout_SFA))));
405	  block_SFB.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(filter_zeros(layout_SFB))));
406	  initialize_block(block_B.host_view(), seed + 2022);
407	  initialize_block(block_C.host_view(), seed + 2023);
408	  initialize_block(block_SFA.host_view(), seed + 2024);
409	  initialize_block(block_SFB.host_view(), seed + 2025);
410	  block_Normconst.at(cutlass::make_Coord(0)) = 2;
411	  block_B.sync_device();
412	  block_C.sync_device();
413	  block_SFA.sync_device();
414	  block_SFB.sync_device();
415	  block_SFD.sync_device();
416	  block_Normconst.sync_device();
417	  return true;
418	}
419	// Populates a Gemm::Arguments structure from the given commandline options
420	typename Gemm::Arguments args_from_options(const Options &options)
421	{
422	  typename Gemm::Arguments arguments {
423	    cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode::kGemm,
424	    {options.m, options.n, options.k, 1},
425	    { // Mainloop arguments
426	      block_A.device_data(), layout_A,
427	      block_B.device_data(), stride_B,
428	      block_E.device_data(), layout_E,
429	      block_SFA.device_data(), layout_SFA,
430	      block_SFB.device_data(), layout_SFB
431	    },
432	    { // Epilogue arguments
433	      {options.alpha, options.beta},
434	      block_C.device_data(), stride_C,
435	      block_D.device_data(), stride_D
436	    }
437	  };
438	  arguments.epilogue.thread.block_scale_factor_ptr = block_SFD.device_data();
439	  arguments.epilogue.thread.norm_constant_ptr      = block_Normconst.device_data();
440	  return arguments;
441	}
442	bool verify(const Options &options) {
443	  using namespace cute;
444	  // Create the arguments for host reference implementation
445	  Tensor tensor_A = make_tensor(make_iterator(block_A_Decompressed.host_data()), layout_A);
446	  Tensor tensor_SFA = make_tensor(block_SFA.host_data(), layout_SFA);
447	  Tensor tensor_B = make_tensor(make_iterator(block_B.host_data()), layout_B);
448	  Tensor tensor_SFB = make_tensor(block_SFB.host_data(), layout_SFB);
449	  Tensor tensor_E = make_tensor(make_iterator(block_E.host_data()), layout_E);
450	
451	  cutlass::reference::host::GettBlockScalingMainloopParams<
452	      ElementAccumulator,                 // ElementAccumulator
453	      decltype(tensor_A),                 // TensorA
454	      decltype(tensor_SFA),               // TensorSfA
455	      decltype(tensor_B),                 // TensorB
456	      decltype(tensor_SFB)                // TensorSfB
457	    > mainloop_params{tensor_A, tensor_SFA, tensor_B, tensor_SFB};
458	  auto tensor_C = cute::make_tensor(make_iterator(block_C.host_data()), layout_C);
459	  auto tensor_D = cute::make_tensor(make_iterator(block_reference_D.host_data()), layout_D);
460	  auto tensor_SFD = cute::make_tensor(block_reference_SFD.host_data(), layout_SFD);
461	
462	  cutlass::reference::host::GettBlockScalingEpilogueParams<
463	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementScalar
464	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementAccumulator
465	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementCompute
466	      decltype(tensor_C),                   // TensorC
467	      decltype(tensor_D),                   // TensorD
468	      decltype(tensor_SFD),                 // TensorSfD
469	      cute::Int<outputVectorSize>,
470	      cutlass::reference::host::SfStrategy::SfDGen
471	    > epilogue_params{options.alpha, options.beta, tensor_C, tensor_D, tensor_SFD, block_Normconst.at(cutlass::make_Coord(0))};
472	  cutlass::reference::host::Gemm3x(mainloop_params, epilogue_params);
473	  // Comparison
474	  block_D.sync_host();
475	
476	  bool passed = cutlass::reference::host::TensorEquals(block_reference_D.host_view(), block_reference_D.host_view());
477	  passed &= (cutlass::reference::host::TensorNorm(block_reference_D.host_view()) > 0);
478	  passed &= (cutlass::reference::host::TensorNorm(block_D.host_view()) > 0);
479	  return passed;
480	}
481	/// Execute a given example GEMM computation
482	template <typename Gemm>
483	int run(Options &options)
484	{
485	  // Initialization
486	  if(!initialize(options))
487	  {
488	    std::cerr << " Initialization failed! " << std::endl;
489	    exit(-1);
490	  }
491	
492	  // Instantiate CUTLASS kernel depending on templates
493	  Gemm gemm;
494	  // Create a structure of gemm kernel arguments suitable for invoking an instance of Gemm
495	  auto arguments = args_from_options(options);
496	  // Using the arguments, query for extra workspace required for matrix multiplication computation
497	  size_t workspace_size = Gemm::get_workspace_size(arguments);
498	  // Allocate workspace memory
499	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
500	  // Check if the problem size is supported or not
501	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.can_implement(arguments));
502	  // Initialize CUTLASS kernel with arguments and workspace pointer
503	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
504	  // Correctness / Warmup iteration
505	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
506	  cudaDeviceSynchronize();
507	  // Check if output from CUTLASS kernel and reference kernel are equal or not
508	  Result result;
509	  result.passed = verify(options);
510	  std::cout << "  Disposition: " << (result.passed ? "Passed" : "Failed") << std::endl;
511	  if (!result.passed) {
512	    exit(-1);
513	  }
514	  // Run profiling loop
515	  if (options.iterations > 0)
516	  {
517	    GpuTimer timer;
518	    timer.start();
519	    for (int iter = 0; iter < options.iterations; ++iter) {
520	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
521	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
522	    }
523	    timer.stop();
524	    // Compute average runtime and GFLOPs.
525	    float elapsed_ms = timer.elapsed_millis();
526	    result.avg_runtime_ms = double(elapsed_ms) / double(options.iterations);
527	    result.gflops = options.gflops(result.avg_runtime_ms / 1000.0);
528	    std::cout << "  Problem Size: " << options.m << 'x' << options.n << 'x' << options.k << std::endl;
529	    std::cout << "  Avg runtime: " << result.avg_runtime_ms << " ms" << std::endl;
530	    std::cout << "  GFLOPS: " << result.gflops << std::endl;
531	  }
532	  return 0;
533	}

32	/*! \file
33	    \brief A Narrow Precision Sparse GEMM example using CUTLASS for the NVIDIA Blackwell SM100 architecture.
34	
35	    This example demonstrates a simple way to instantiate and run a blockscaled NVFP4 Sparse GEMM on the NVIDIA Blackwell SM100 architecture.
36	
37	    The Blackwell SM100 CUTLASS kernel uses the new Block Scaled Tensor Core MMA Instructions (tcgen05.mma.blockscaled) introduced
38	    on the Blackwell architecture (sm100a) which have 2x throughput compared to fp8 Tensor Core MMA instructions (tcgen05.mma)
39	    and 4x throughput compared to fp8 Hopper Tensor Core MMA Instructions (WGMMA) (See https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution).
40	
41	    Similar to 83_blackwell_sparse_gemm, this kernel leverages:
42	    1. Per-SM memory called Tensor Memory (TMEM)  (Please refer to CUDA 12.8 docs on https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/).
43	
44	    2. The extended warp-specialized kernel design introduced in Hopper enabled by use of TMEM
45	    which allows us to decouple the execution of MMA and epilogue into separate warps.
46	
47	    3. A new SW controlled dynamic scheduler based on cluster launch control (See https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution).
48	
49	    Usage:
50	      $ ./examples/84_blackwell_narrow_precision_sparse_gemm/84a_blackwell_nvfp4_bf16_sparse_gemm --m=2048 --n=2048 --k=2048
51	*/

345	/// Helper to initialize a block of device data
346	template <typename Element, typename Layout>
347	void initialize_tensor(
348	  cutlass::TensorView<Element, Layout> view,
349	  uint64_t seed) {
350	
351	  double scope_max, scope_min;
352	  int bits_input = cutlass::sizeof_bits<Element>::value;
353	
354	  if (bits_input == 1) {
355	    scope_max = 2;
356	    scope_min = 0;
357	  }
358	    else if (bits_input <= 6) {
359	    scope_max = 2;
360	    scope_min = -2;
361	  }
362	  else if (bits_input <= 8) {
363	    if constexpr (cute::is_same_v<Element, cutlass::float_ue8m0_t>){
364	      scope_max = 4;
365	      scope_min = 1;
366	    }
367	    else {
368	      scope_max = 1;
369	      scope_min = -1;
370	    }
371	  }
372	  else{
373	    scope_max = 4;
374	    scope_min = -4;
375	  }
376	  cutlass::reference::host::TensorFillRandomUniform(
377	    view, seed, scope_max, scope_min, 0);
378	}

380	/// Initialize operands to be used in the GEMM and reference GEMM
381	bool initialize(const Options &options) {
382	
383	  problem_shape = make_tuple(options.m, options.n, options.k, options.l);
384	
385	  // * Get A B C D size
386	  stride_A = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, {options.m, options.k, 1});
387	  stride_B = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideB{}, {options.n, options.k, 1});
388	  stride_C = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideC{}, {options.m, options.n, 1});
389	  stride_D = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideD{}, {options.m, options.n, 1});
390	  layout_A = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(problem_shape);
391	  layout_E = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(problem_shape);
392	  layout_SFA = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(problem_shape);
393	  layout_SFB = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFB(problem_shape);
394	
395	  // * Get ACompress & E size
396	  CompressorUtility compressor_utility(problem_shape, stride_A);
397	
398	  // TensorE
399	  // In unit of ElementE (uint8_t), after alignment requirement
400	  // M-dim: TensorEAtom_M alignment
401	  // K-dim: TensorEAtom_K alignment
402	  int KAlignedE = compressor_utility.get_metadata_k_physical();
403	  int MAlignedE = compressor_utility.get_metadata_m_physical();
404	
405	  // TensorA Compressed
406	  // In unit of ElementARaw, after alignment requirement
407	  // M-dim: TMA alignment
408	  // K-dim: TMA alignment
409	  int KAlignedAC = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_k_physical();
410	  int MAlignedAC = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_m_physical();
411	
412	  stride_A_compressed = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, cute::make_shape(options.m, KAlignedAC, options.l));
413	  stride_E            = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideE{}, cute::make_shape(MAlignedE, KAlignedE, options.l));
414	
415	  // * Get SFA & SFB size
416	  auto k_blks = cutlass::ceil_div(options.k, cute::size<1>(shape(SfAtom{})));
417	  auto m_blks = cutlass::ceil_div(options.m, Blk_MN{});
418	  auto n_blks = cutlass::ceil_div(options.n, Blk_MN{});
419	
420	  // * Allocate Tensor
421	  auto a_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(options.m * options.l, options.k);
422	  auto b_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(options.k, options.n * options.l);
423	  auto e_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(MAlignedE * options.l, KAlignedE);
424	  auto a_comp_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(MAlignedAC * options.l, KAlignedAC);
425	  auto c_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(options.m * options.l, options.n);
426	  auto d_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(options.m * options.l, options.n);
427	  auto sfa_coord   = cutlass::make_Coord(m_blks * Blk_MN{} * options.l, k_blks * Blk_SF{});
428	  auto sfb_coord   = cutlass::make_Coord(n_blks * Blk_MN{} * options.l, k_blks * Blk_SF{});
429	
430	  tensor_A.resize(a_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagA>::layout_factory(a_coord, stride_factor_A));
431	  tensor_A_compressed.resize(a_comp_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagA>::layout_factory(a_comp_coord, stride_factor_A));
432	  tensor_B.resize(b_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagB>::layout_factory(b_coord, stride_factor_B));
433	  tensor_E.resize(e_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagE>::layout_factory(e_coord, stride_factor_E));
434	  tensor_C.resize(c_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagC>::layout_factory(c_coord, stride_factor_C));
435	  tensor_D.resize(c_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagD>::layout_factory(d_coord, stride_factor_D));
436	  reference_D.resize(c_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagD>::layout_factory(d_coord, stride_factor_D), false);
437	  tensor_SFA.resize(sfa_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagA>::layout_factory(sfa_coord, stride_factor_A));
438	  tensor_SFB.resize(sfb_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagB>::layout_factory(sfb_coord, stride_factor_B));
439	
440	  // * Random init
441	  initialize_tensor(tensor_A.host_view(), seed + 2021);
442	  initialize_tensor(tensor_B.host_view(), seed + 2022);
443	  initialize_tensor(tensor_C.host_view(), seed + 2023);
444	  initialize_tensor(tensor_SFA.host_view(), seed + 2024);
445	  initialize_tensor(tensor_SFB.host_view(), seed + 2025);
446	  cutlass::reference::host::TensorCopy(reference_D.host_view(), tensor_C.host_view());
447	
448	  // * Random fill 50% A with zero
449	  compressor_utility.structure_sparse_zero_mask_fill(tensor_A.host_data(), static_cast<int>(seed + 2023));
450	
451	  tensor_A.sync_device();
452	  tensor_B.sync_device();
453	  tensor_C.sync_device();
454	  tensor_SFA.sync_device();
455	  tensor_SFB.sync_device();
456	
457	  // * Compress
458	  cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo hw_info;
459	  hw_info.device_id = 0;
460	  hw_info.sm_count = cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo::query_device_multiprocessor_count(hw_info.device_id);
461	  typename Compressor::Arguments arguments{
462	    problem_shape,
463	    {tensor_A.device_data(),
464	      stride_A,
465	      tensor_A_compressed.device_data(),
466	      tensor_E.device_data()},
467	    {hw_info}
468	  };
469	
470	  Compressor compressor_op;
471	  size_t workspace_size = Compressor::get_workspace_size(arguments);
472	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
473	
474	  cutlass::Status status {cutlass::Status::kSuccess };
475	  status = compressor_op.can_implement(arguments);
476	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
477	    return false;
478	  }
479	
480	  status = compressor_op.initialize(arguments, workspace.get());
481	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
482	    return false;
483	  }
484	
485	  status = compressor_op.run();
486	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
487	    return false;
488	  }
489	
490	  auto result = cudaDeviceSynchronize();
491	  if (result != cudaSuccess) {
492	    return false;
493	  }
494	
495	  tensor_E.sync_host();
496	  tensor_A_compressed.sync_host();
497	
498	  return true;
499	}

501	// Populates a Gemm::Arguments structure from the given commandline options
502	typename Gemm::Arguments args_from_options(const Options &options)
503	{
504	  using ArrayElementA = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::ArrayElementA;
505	  using ArrayElementB = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::ArrayElementB;
506	
507	  typename Gemm::Arguments arguments {
508	    cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode::kGemm,
509	    {options.m, options.n, options.k, 1},
510	    {
511	      reinterpret_cast<ArrayElementA *>(tensor_A_compressed.device_data()), layout_A,
512	      reinterpret_cast<ArrayElementB *>(tensor_B.device_data()), stride_B,
513	      tensor_E.device_data(), layout_E,
514	      tensor_SFA.device_data(), layout_SFA,
515	      tensor_SFB.device_data(), layout_SFB
516	    },
517	    {
518	      {options.alpha, options.beta},
519	      tensor_C.device_data(), stride_C,
520	      tensor_D.device_data(), stride_D
521	    }
522	  };
523	
524	  return arguments;
525	}
526	
527	bool verify(const Options &options) {
528	  using namespace cute;
529	
530	  // Create the arguments for host reference implementation
531	  auto A = make_tensor(make_iterator(tensor_A.host_data()), layout_A);
532	  auto SFA = make_tensor(tensor_SFA.host_data(), layout_SFA);
533	  auto B = make_tensor(make_iterator(tensor_B.host_data()),
534	    make_layout(make_shape(options.n, options.k, options.l), stride_B));
535	  auto SFB = make_tensor(tensor_SFB.host_data(), layout_SFB);
536	
537	  cutlass::reference::host::GettMainloopParams<
538	      ElementAccumulator,
539	      decltype(A),
540	      decltype(B),
541	      decltype(SFA),
542	      decltype(SFB)> mainloop_params{A, SFA, B, SFB};
543	
544	  auto C = make_tensor(make_iterator(tensor_C.host_data()),
545	    make_layout(make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.l), stride_C));
546	  auto D = make_tensor(make_iterator(reference_D.host_data()),
547	    make_layout(make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.l), stride_D));
548	
549	  cutlass::reference::host::GettBlockScalingEpilogueParams<
550	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementScalar
551	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementAccumulator
552	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementCompute
553	      decltype(C),                          // TensorC
554	      decltype(D)                           // TensorD
555	    > epilogue_params{
556	      options.alpha,
557	      options.beta,
558	      C,
559	      D};
560	
561	  cutlass::reference::host::Gemm3x(mainloop_params, epilogue_params);
562	
563	  // Comparison
564	  tensor_D.sync_host();
565	  bool passed = cutlass::reference::host::TensorEquals(reference_D.host_view(), tensor_D.host_view());
566	  passed &= (cutlass::reference::host::TensorNorm(reference_D.host_view()) > 0);
567	  passed &= (cutlass::reference::host::TensorNorm(tensor_D.host_view()) > 0);
568	
569	  return passed;
570	}
571	
572	/// Execute a given example GEMM computation
573	template <typename Gemm>
574	int run(Options &options)
575	{
576	  auto init_pass = initialize(options);
577	  if (not init_pass) {
578	    std::cout << "Initialization failure" << std::endl;
579	    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
580	  }
581	
582	  // Instantiate CUTLASS kernel depending on templates
583	  Gemm gemm;
584	
585	  // Create a structure of gemm kernel arguments suitable for invoking an instance of Gemm
586	  auto arguments = args_from_options(options);
587	
588	  // Using the arguments, query for extra workspace required for matrix multiplication computation
589	  size_t workspace_size = Gemm::get_workspace_size(arguments);
590	
591	  // Allocate workspace memory
592	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
593	
594	  // Check if the problem size is supported or not
595	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.can_implement(arguments));
596	
597	  // Initialize CUTLASS kernel with arguments and workspace pointer
598	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
599	
600	  // Correctness / Warmup iteration
601	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
602	
603	  cudaDeviceSynchronize();
604	
605	  // Check if output from CUTLASS kernel and reference kernel are equal or not
606	  Result result;
607	  result.passed = verify(options);
608	
609	  std::cout << "  Disposition: " << (result.passed ? "Passed" : "Failed") << std::endl;
610	
611	  if (not result.passed) {
612	    exit(-1);
613	  }
614	
615	  // Run profiling loop
616	  if (options.iterations > 0)
617	  {
618	    GpuTimer timer;
619	    timer.start();
620	    for (int iter = 0; iter < options.iterations; ++iter) {
621	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
622	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
623	    }
624	    timer.stop();
625	
626	    // Compute average runtime and GFLOPs.
627	    float elapsed_ms = timer.elapsed_millis();
628	    result.avg_runtime_ms = double(elapsed_ms) / double(options.iterations);
629	    result.gflops = options.gflops(result.avg_runtime_ms / 1000.0);
630	
631	
632	    std::cout << "  Problem Size: " << options.m << 'x' << options.n << 'x' << options.k << std::endl;
633	    std::cout << "  Avg runtime: " << result.avg_runtime_ms << " ms" << std::endl;
634	    std::cout << "  GFLOPS: " << result.gflops << std::endl;
635	  }
636	
637	  return 0;
638	}

647	  // and must have compute capability at least 100.
648	  if (__CUDACC_VER_MAJOR__ < 12 || (__CUDACC_VER_MAJOR__ == 12 && __CUDACC_VER_MINOR__ < 8)) {
649	    std::cerr << "This example requires CUDA 12.8 or newer." << std::endl;
650	    // Returning zero so this test passes on older Toolkits. Its actions are no-op.
651	    return 0;
652	  }
653	
654	  cudaDeviceProp props;
655	  int current_device_id;
656	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&current_device_id));
657	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&props, current_device_id));
658	  cudaError_t error = cudaGetDeviceProperties(&props, 0);
659	  if (not (props.major == 10 && props.minor == 0)) {
660	    std::cerr << "This example requires a GPU of NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture (compute capability 100)." << std::endl;
661	    return 0;
662	  }
663	
664	  //
665	  // Parse options
666	  //
667	
668	  Options options;
669	
670	  options.parse(argc, args);
671	
672	  if (options.help) {
673	    options.print_usage(std::cout) << std::endl;
674	    return 0;
675	  }
676	
677	  //
678	  // Evaluate CUTLASS kernels
679	  //
680	#if defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM100_SUPPORTED)
681	  run<Gemm>(options);
682	#endif // defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM100_SUPPORTED)
683	
684	  return 0;

   - `ModelOptFp4LinearMethod` 类或类似的 `LinearMethodBase` 实现
   - `create_weights()` / `process_weights_after_loading()` / `apply()` 三个 hook 各自的职责
   - 重点：apply() 里是怎么 dispatch 到不同 backend (Marlin vs b12x vs CUTLASS) 的

2. **b12x dispatch 逻辑**：

   - dispatch 阈值（`SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD=48`）怎么用

3. **层级配置**：
   - sglang 怎么知道某层走 modelopt path：通过 `config.json` 的 `quantization_config.quant_method = "modelopt"` 全局开关
   - 是否有 per-layer override 机制（quantization_config.exclude_modules / ignored_layers / lm_head 之外的别的字段）

180	def scaled_fp4_quant(
181	    input: torch.Tensor, input_global_scale: torch.Tensor
182	) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
183	    """
184	    Quantize input tensor to FP4 and return quantized tensor and scale.
185	
186	    This function quantizes the last dimension of the given tensor `input`. For
187	    every 16 consecutive elements, a single dynamically computed scaling factor
188	    is shared. This scaling factor is quantized using the `input_global_scale`
189	    and is stored in a swizzled layout (see
190	    https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution/#tcgen05-mma-scale-factor-b-layout-4x).
191	
192	    Args:
193	        input: The input tensor to be quantized to FP4
194	        input_global_scale: A scalar scaling factor for the entire tensor.
195	
196	    Returns:
197	        Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]: The output tensor in FP4 but every
198	            two values are packed into a uint8 and float8_e4m3 scaling factors
199	            in a sizzled layout.
200	    """

102	def benchmark(batch_size, provider, N, K):
103	    # M, N, K = batch_size, 4096, 8192
104	    run_step = 100
105	    dtype = torch.float16 if "fp16" in provider else torch.bfloat16
106	    M = batch_size
107	    a = torch.randn((M, K), dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
108	    b = torch.randn((N, K), dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
109	    a_global_scale = (
110	        (FLOAT8_E4M3_MAX * FLOAT4_E2M1_MAX) / torch.amax(a.flatten(), dim=-1)
111	    ).to(torch.float32)
112	    b_global_scale = (
113	        (FLOAT8_E4M3_MAX * FLOAT4_E2M1_MAX) / torch.amax(b.flatten(), dim=-1)
114	    ).to(torch.float32)
115	    alpha = 1.0 / (a_global_scale * b_global_scale)
116	    a_fp4, a_scale_interleaved = scaled_fp4_quant(a, a_global_scale)
117	    b_fp4, b_scale_interleaved = scaled_fp4_quant(b, b_global_scale)
118	
119	    start_event = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
120	    end_event = torch.cuda.Event(enable_timing=True)
121	
122	    # Bridging the gap between CPU and GPU
123	    for _ in range(25):
124	        c = a @ b.t()
125	    # Warmup
126	    for _ in range(5):
127	        cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm(
128	            a_fp4, b_fp4, a_scale_interleaved, b_scale_interleaved, alpha, dtype
129	        )
130	    start_event.record()
131	    for _ in range(run_step):
132	        cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm(
133	            a_fp4, b_fp4, a_scale_interleaved, b_scale_interleaved, alpha, dtype
134	        )
135	    end_event.record()
136	    end_event.synchronize()
137	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
138	    ms = start_event.elapsed_time(end_event) / run_step
139	
140	    tflops = lambda ms: (2 * M * N * K) * 1e-9 / ms
141	    return tflops(ms)
142	
143	
144	def prepare_shapes(args):
145	    KN_model_names = []
146	    models_tps = list(itertools.product(args.models, args.tp_sizes))
147	    for model, tp_size in models_tps:
148	        assert model in WEIGHT_SHAPES
149	        for KN, tp_split_dim in copy.deepcopy(WEIGHT_SHAPES[model]):
150	            KN[tp_split_dim] = KN[tp_split_dim] // tp_size
151	            KN.append(model)
152	            KN_model_names.append(KN)
153	    return KN_model_names
154	
155	
156	if __name__ == "__main__":
157	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
158	    parser.add_argument(
159	        "--models",
160	        nargs="+",
161	        type=str,
162	        default=["meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct"],
163	        help="List of models to benchmark",
164	    )
165	    parser.add_argument(
166	        "--tp-sizes",
167	        nargs="+",
168	        type=int,
169	        default=[1],
170	        help="List of tensor parallel sizes",
171	    )
172	    args = parser.parse_args()
173	
174	    # Check architecture compatibility - FP4 operations require sm100a/sm103a
175	    major, minor = get_device_capability()
176	    if major is None or major < 10:  # Requires compute capability 10.0+ (sm100a/sm103a)
177	        print("Skipping NVIDIA FP4 scaled GEMM benchmark")
178	        if major is not None:
179	            print(f"FP4 operations require sm100a/sm103a, but found sm{major}{minor}")
180	        else:
181	            print("Could not determine device capability")
182	    else:
183	        KN_model_names = prepare_shapes(args)
184	
185	        # Limit iterations in CI
186	        if IS_CI:
187	            KN_model_names = KN_model_names[:2]  # Only test first 2 shapes in CI
188

**话题 A：本仓库的 "fast validate" 模式**

用户说："不是 mini_bench, 是类似 gemm 工作中的 fast validate, few chunks prefill + some tokens decode"。意思是历史的 GEMM 工作有一个轻量的端到端 validation 脚本：跑几个 prefill chunk + 一些 decode token，快速判断 kernel 接入后的正确性 + 吞吐变化。不是全量 accuracy eval，也不是 mini_bench。

调查目标（<600 words）：
- 在 `/user_4813494d/openbmb/` 下找这个 fast validate 脚本（关键词：`fast_validate`, `prefill_chunks`, `decode_tokens`, `few_prefill`, `quick_check`, `smoke`，可能在 `bench/`, `eval/`, `docs/gemm/`, `docs/decode/`）
- 看 `docs/gemm/methodology.md` / `docs/gemm/sop.md` / `docs/decode/` 里是否描述了这个 SOP

- 如果找到，回报：脚本路径、运行命令、关键参数（prefill chunk 数量、decode token 数量、对比基线方式）

**话题 B：CUTLASS sparse 2:4 metadata 提取 (sm_120 NVFP4)**

我们已经有 SparseGPT + GPTQ 量化产物（`/user_4813494d/openbmb/quant/sparse_fp4/outputs/sparse_nvfp4_calib90/`），87 个 MLP 层的 NVFP4 weight 中每 4 列恰好有 ≥2 个 0 (50% strict 2:4 + 3.4% 量化后 over-sparse)。要给 CUTLASS sm_120 sparse GEMM 生成正确的 2:4 metadata。

调查目标（<800 words）：
- 看 `/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/sparse_fp4_probe/cutlass-main/examples/80_blackwell_geforce_sparse_gemm/80b_blackwell_geforce_nvfp4_nvfp4_sparse_gemm.cu` 完整流程
- 重点：`CompressorUtility` 的使用方式（line ~322 附近）：
  - 输入 dense weight (含 0)，输出 compressed weight (一半 size) + metadata E
  - metadata E 的 layout / dtype / size 公式
  - host 端调还是 device 端调
  - 一次性 setup cost vs runtime cost
- `cutlass::transform::kernel::sparse_gemm_compressor` (line 76 include) 的接口
- compressed weight 和 metadata 的物理布局：
  - compressed A 是 [M, K/2] 还是 [M_aligned, K_aligned/2]
  - metadata E 是 [M, K/8] uint8 (每 2 个 4-bit indices per byte) 还是别的

- 三个 example (80a/80b/84a) 比较：哪个最适合给 inference 模型用？关键看：output 类型、SF output 开关、kernel schedule
- NVFP4 SF (scale factor) 在 sparse 路径里是怎么 layout 的：SFA layout 公式（compress 是否影响 SF）

1	# sm_120 + 容器云 + NVFP4 受限场景 GEMM 调优 SOP
2	
3	事实来源：4 路 subagent 调研 + 本仓实测。
4	
5	> 调优纪律：本 SOP 是项目契约。任何 patch 落地前必须满足 §0 的产出物前置；违反契约的"动手"全部按赌博论。
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 0. 契约（不可违反的 4 条）
10	
11	1. **没有 charter（§1）= 不允许动手**。charter 缺失则不知道目标。
12	2. **没有硬件常数表（§2）+ SOL 表（§3）= 不允许动手**。不知道物理上限就不知道何时停。
13	3. **没有 reference baseline（§4）= 不允许动手**。不知道"不努力能拿多少"，可能整个项目是负贡献。
14	4. **每一改动必须能 attribute 到 §3 SOL 表里某个 (shape, M) 的 gap 缩小**。不能 attribute = 不允许 merge。
15	
16	---
17	
18	## 1. Stage 0 — Charter
19	
20	写一页 charter 固化 3 件事：
21	
22	| 字段 | 内容 |
23	|---|---|
24	| 目标形状直方图 | (M, N, K, dtype) 的真实分布；prefill / decode / spec 各占多少 |
25	| 成功度量 | 双指标：端到端 token/s + kernel-level SOL% |
26	| 约束 | 容器云、ncu 锁、cuda graph 兼容、提交包 ≤ 2 GB 等 |
27	
28	产出物：`charter.md`。
29	
30	---
31	
32	## 2. Stage 1 — 硬件常数表
33	
34	**14 个 GEMM 视角的物理常数**（RTX 6000D / sm_120）：
35	
36	计算面：N_SM=156，f_clk~2.43 GHz boost，N_TC/SM=4，W/SM=64，T/W=32，mma(NVFP4)~8× BF16。
37	
38	内存面：BW_HBM~1.6 TB/s SOL，C_L2=96 MB，Reg_File/SM=256 KB，Reg/Thread≤255，SMEM/SM=128 KB，SMEM/CTA≤99 KB，N_Banks=32，L_HBM/L_SMEM/L_MMA ≈ 400-600 / 20-30 / 16-32 cycle。
39	
40	**Occupancy 三约束**（取最小）：W_active ≤ min(W/SM, Reg_File ÷ (Reg/Thread × T/W), SMEM/SM ÷ SMEM/CTA × Warps/CTA)。
41	
42	**硬约束**：Reg/Thread ≤ 255，SMEM/CTA ≤ 99 KB，TMA 16B 对齐，warp=32，NVFP4 mma shape m16n8k64。
43	
44	**sm_120 物理已知坑**：无 TMEM（FA4/tcgen05 全死），无 WGMMA（sm_90 mainloop 不可用），无 cluster≥2 / DSMEM / TMA multicast，ncu profiling SKU 锁，CUPTI Range Profiler / PC Sampling 在 Blackwell 整族砍。
45	
46	产出物：`docs/gemm/hardware.md`。
47	
48	---
49	
50	## 3. Stage 2 — SOL & Roofline
51	
52	**核心公式（Williams roofline, CACM 2009）**：
53	```
54	AI = FLOPs / Bytes_moved_from_DRAM
55	T_compute_LB = FLOPs / peak_FLOPS_dtype
56	T_mem_LB    = Bytes_traffic / BW_HBM
57	T_kernel_LB = max(T_compute_LB, T_mem_LB)
58	SOL%        = T_kernel_LB / T_measured        (>80% 够好；>90% 顶级)
59	machine_balance AI* = peak_FLOPS / BW_HBM
60	```
61	
62	**M regime 4 段**（NVFP4 / sm_120 上 AI 已抬高约 4×）：
63	
64	| M 区间 | AI 量级 | 主导瓶颈 | 最优 kernel 范式 |
65	|---|---|---|---|
66	| M=1 (decode/GEMV) | ~4 | weight HBM BW | weight stationary + splitK；Marlin 范式 |
67	| M=16-64 (small batch) | ~30 | weight + activation BW | 小 tileM (16/32) + splitK + dequant fused |
68	| M=128-1024 (transition) | ~100-500 | transition | 中 tileM (64/128) + 多 stage |
69	| M ≥ 4096 (prefill) | ≥ AI* | TC compute | 大 tile (128×256+) + cluster TMA；CUTLASS 范式 |
70	
71	当前 SOAR `SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD=48` 物理依据：M=48 是 weight-bound→transition regime 边界。
72	
73	### 3.0bis cost model L2 reuse 因子修订（2026-05-11 α-recalibrate）
74	
75	原 `T_mem_LB = Bytes_traffic / BW_HBM` 假设 weight cold load。但 microbench 重复同一 (shape, M) 时 weight 持续留 L2 → wall < T_mem_LB → 表面 SOL > 100% 反模式。production 多层并发 + chain verify 是**部分 reuse**。
76	
77	production trace 实证（2026-05-11，单 chat 200 tok，NVFP4+EAGLE-3 D7）：
78	- SB Marlin 主 tile (`thread_m_blocks=1, n=8, k=8, stages=8`): 33.8 µs/call avg
79	- gate_up 形状 cold SOL = 75.5 MB / 1.4 TB/s = 54 µs
80	- 实测 / cold SOL = 0.63 → production reuse factor ~37%
81	- single-user 全走 SB Marlin path；CUTLASS NVFP4 / b12x 在 M < 48 完全没跑
82	
83	**修订 cost model**：
84	```
85	reuse_factor(shape, regime) ≈ {
86	    microbench (warm L2): 0.2-0.4
87	    production single-user: ~0.6
88	    production multi-user / Smax: ~0.8-1.0
89	}
90	T_mem_eff = T_mem_LB × reuse_factor
91	T_kernel_eff_LB = max(T_compute_LB, T_mem_eff)
92	production_SOL% = T_kernel_eff_LB / T_measured_in_production
93	```
94	
95	含义：microbench SOL > 100% 不代表 kernel 已达上限。真正的 attack signal = **production trace per-kernel wall** ÷ T_mem_LB × reuse_factor(prod) 之后看是否 < 0.5。`sol_table.md` ❄ 标记（SOL > 100% warm cache）不能作为停手依据，必须 production trace 二次验证。
96	
97	### 3.0ter production trace attribution 是新攻击面选择的 ground truth（2026-05-11）
98	
99	- microbench 看哪个 shape "SOL 低" → 可能误导（warm cache 假胜 + production 路径不同）
100	- 正确方法：production trace (sglang `/start_profile` + `decode_trace_breakdown.py`) → kernel family wall-time 占比 → 占比 > 5% 且 reuse-factor 修正后 SOL < 50% 的 family 才值得攻击
101	- 见 `outputs/profile_prod_20260511/attribution_prod.md`
102	
103	---
104	
105	## 3.5 quick_validate 性能闸门（唯一标准）
106	
107	`bench/quick_validate.sh` 是 SOP Stage 5/6/7 性能收益的**唯一最终评估标准**。`mini_bench.sh` / `toolkit/bench_serving.sh` 不再作为闸门。
108	
109	**为什么不是 mini_bench**：长 bench 5-15 分钟，时间窗口放大冷启动 / DVFS sticky / autotune cache miss / 热降频抖动。单跑 ±3% 漂移，与 1-3% patch 收益量级相同 → SNR 差。A/B/A interleave 需要 1-3 小时。
110	
111	**quick_validate 设计**（`bench/quick_validate.sh`）：
112	
113	1. Prefill：5 个 chunk-sized prompt (15002 / 15402 / 18202 / 20402 / 21002 tokens)，`max_tokens=1`，输出 prefill_tok/s (median / min / p90 / mean / stdev)
114	2. Decode single-stream：5 次 short prompt (32 tok) × max_tokens=128，ignore_eos；M=11 spec verify 路径
115	3. Decode batch concurrency：bs∈{8,16,32}，ignore_eos，max_tokens=128；全 batch warmup 经过 bs=32 避免 cold path（R3 教训）；每 bs 2 trial 取 min
116	
117	总耗时 ~25 秒一跑。归档 `outputs/quick_validate/<TS>_<label>.json`。
118	
119	**A/B/A 流程**：至少 3 baseline + 2 patch run；每次 kill 后重启 server。
120	
121	**通过阈值**：收益 ≥ 1% lock-in 候选；**SNR ≥ 3×**（patch 收益 ≥ 3 × baseline stdev）；跨 5 指标无单一退化 > 噪声层。
122	
123	**quick_validate 不充分的 patch 类型（必须升级到 full eval gate）**（R-b12x-bucket64 教训）：
124	
125	quick_validate 是稳态合成负载（固定 batch sizes），dispatch 在每个 batch 内走单一 bucket。production EAGLE-3 chain verify accept_rate ≈ 0.34 让 M 在 bucket 边界横跳触发 kernel cache thrashing — quick_validate 看不见。
126	
127	| patch 类型 | 为什么不够 |
128	|---|---|
129	| `_M_BUCKETS` 改动 | bucket 边界横跳 → kernel cache thrashing，仅异质长输出（mcq）下显现 |
130	| `_resolve_tile` fallback 路径变动 | quick_validate 命中固定 6 shapes，看不到 fallback |
131	| `MARLIN_UPPER` 改动 | dispatch 拐点变化 → kernel 占比改变 |
132	| `CUTLASS_OVERRIDE` 增删 | 同上 |
133	
134	实证：R-b12x-bucket64 quick_validate bs=8 +1.98% 但 full eval ori_acc -1.06pp + 8.7% 慢；R-marlin-fp32reduce decode_single +41.5% 但 full eval -1.7%。
135	
136	**full eval gate 通过阈值**：ori_acc 不退化 > 0.3pp；duration 不退化 > 1%；overall_acc 持平 baseline；effective tok/s ≥ baseline -1%。
137	
138	### 3.5.1 mini_bench 三档前置闸（dispatch / 路径切换专用）
139	
140	**触发条件**：patch 改动了 dispatch 路径、kernel 选择阈值、Python wrapper 调用链。例：`SGLANG_B12X_MAX_M` / `MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD` 阈值调整、`CUTLASS_OVERRIDE` / `MARLIN_UPPER` / `_M_BUCKETS` 增删、替换 dispatch 函数（如把 `mm_fp4(cutlass)` 换 `b12x_gemm_fp4` 这种语义级切换）。
141	
142	**为什么不只信微基**：kernel-isolation microbench 完全脱离生产环境的 stream / cache / memory pressure。R-b12x-prefill 案例：bench 显示 std_o M=2048 b12x 1.78× kernel 加速，e2e mini_bench S1 反退化 +19.9%。Python wrapper overhead < 5 µs/call（无法解释 +25s S1 退化），真实根因未定位，候选：output tensor alloc / CUDA stream sync / SF cache 与并发 attention kernel 冲突。重点不是定位 — 重点是接受 **microbench 不能预测 e2e**。
143	
144	**前置流程**（quick_validate / sanity / full eval 之前）：
145	1. post-patch mini_bench S1 + S8 + Smax 三档全跑
146	2. 三档全部 ≥ baseline -1% 才进入 sanity smoke + quick_validate
147	3. 任一档退化 > 1.5% 立即 git checkout 回滚
148	
149	**三档定义**：
150	- S1（1 req）= prefill-dominated, Python overhead 最敏感
151	- S8（8 reqs）= 中等并发, b12x kernel 自身收益可见
152	- Smax（32 reqs）= max 并发, 大量 prefill chunks 并行
153	
154	**通过判据**：每档 new ≤ baseline × 1.005（噪声层 0.5%）。单档退化 > 0.5% 但 < 1.5%：复测一次；> 1.5% 直接拒。
155	
156	实证：R-b12x-prefill bench_long_m M=2048 1.78x，所有 microbench 看似 PASS — 直接进 quick_validate 会因 sanity 通过而 lock-in；mini_bench 三档闸把 S1 +19.9% 抓出。
157	
158	---
159	
160	## 3.6 离线 Sanity 闸门（quick_validate 之前必跑）
161	
162	性能数字漂亮但输出乱码 = 整轮作废。bench 测的是 token/s，不验证语义；patch 把模型搞坏了 token/s 反而可能升。
163	
164	**3 条强制 smoke chat**（curl `/v1/chat/completions`）：(1) 语义"用一句话介绍量子计算" max_tokens=50；(2) 数学"5+7等于几？" max_tokens=30；(3) 中文"周末计划" max_tokens=50。
165	
166	**通过准则（任一不过 → quick_validate 不跑）**：输出可读（中文连贯句，无乱码 / 重复 token）；长度合理（接近 max_tokens 或显式 EOS）；语义对齐（答案与问题相关）；server 日志无 NaN/Inf/illegal memory。
167	
168	为什么是 chat 而不是 mcq：CLAUDE.md 明确禁止 mcq 作健康判据；chat 长答暴露 attention / dispatch / dequant silent corruption。反模式：跳过 sanity 直接 quick_validate；max_tokens=5 / temperature=0；prompt 太短；同一 prompt 跑 3 次。
169	
170	---
171	
172	## 3.7 Bench 执行纪律
173	
174	**3.7.1 严禁后台运行（用户硬规则）**：所有耗时 GPU 任务前台运行。`/goal` 唤醒机制：goal active 时前台一旦空闲（没有 blocking 命令）就唤醒 Claude 迭代。禁的不是 background 本身，是**让前台空掉**。
175	
176	| 写法 | 前台占用 | goal 唤醒 | 允许 |
177	|---|---|---|---|
178	| 前台 `bash long_task.sh`（显式 timeout） | blocking | 不 | ✓ 长任务首选 |
179	| `nohup ... &` / `bash server.sh &` 后接前台 `until grep -m1 ...` | poll 阻塞 | 不 | ✓ |
180	| `nohup ... &` 后直接 return | 空 | 是 | ✗ |
181	| `Bash(run_in_background=true)` / `Monitor` 挂着等事件 | 空 | 是 | ✗ |
182	
183	正确做法（server 启动等 ready）：
184	```bash
185	bash eval/start_eagle.sh > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
186	until grep -m1 -qE "Uvicorn running on|Traceback|ERROR|Killed|OOM" /tmp/server.log; do sleep 2; done
187	```
188	Full eval 25min 直接前台 `Bash(timeout=1800000ms) bash eval/run_public_eval_full.sh`。
189	
190	**3.7.2 启动脚本必须 clean**：bench 前 `git status` 检查 `eval/start_eagle.sh` / `bench/quick_validate.sh` 无 uncommitted edit（R5b 教训）。
191	
192	**3.7.3 服务器停启**：杀 sglang **只用** `bash bench/kill_sglang.sh`，禁止 `pkill -f sglang`（会杀系统进程整机重启）。等 ready 用 `curl /v1/models` 或日志 `Uvicorn running on`，不用 `/health`。
193	
194	**3.7.4 一个 bench 一个 process**：A1 → kill → B → kill → A2，每次 kill 完彻底确认（`curl /v1/models` connection refused）再启下一个。不允许复用上一个 server 跑多个 patch；不允许开两个端口平行跑（GPU 显存 + autotune cache 不共享）。
195	
196	---
197	
198	**RTX 6000D NVFP4 peak**：peak_FP4 ≈ 156 × 4 × 2048 × 2.43e9 ≈ 3.1 PFLOPS（理论）；实测 SOL ≈ 70-80% × 理论 ≈ 2.2-2.5 PFLOPS。
199	
200	**SOL 计算示例（gate_up GEMM 4096×32768）**：M=1 decode T_kernel_LB=47 µs（memory-bound）；M=8192 prefill T_kernel_LB=710 µs（compute-bound）。任何 M=1 实测 < 47 µs 要么 cache 命中要么测错。
201	
202	产出物：`docs/gemm/sol_table.md`，每个 (shape, M) 一行 `| shape | M | N | K | AI | bound | T_LB µs | target SOL% | 当前 SOL% | gap µs |`。
203	
204	---
205	
206	## 4. Stage 3 — Reference Baseline
207	
208	reference 候选：cuBLAS / cuBLASLt FP4（sm_120 dispatcher bug 60% 选错 kernel）、CUTLASS profiler 默认、sgl-kernel `cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm`（当前生产 baseline）、flashinfer `mm_fp4(backend="cutlass")` + autotune cache。
209	
210	**Lock-in baseline 6 件套**：(1) git commit；(2) 环境 fingerprint（driver / CUDA / 容器 digest / Python 包）；(3) 数字 + 分布（median / IQR / min / max / N / CV）；(4) trace artifact（nsys .nsys-rep + sqlite）；(5) 静态 artifact（cubin SASS、ptxas -v）；(6) 环境 telemetry（DCGM/NVML SM clock / power / temp）。
211	
212	决策点：reference > 80% SOL → 直接上线；gap < 10% → 回 Stage 0 重评估。
213	
214	---
215	
216	## 5. Stage 4 — 瓶颈识别（容器云适配版）
217	
218	**指标可信度**：SASS instruction count / ptxas -v / clock64 cycle / theoretical occupancy = ✓（编译期或频率解耦）；HBM bw 比例 / achieved occupancy = ⚠ runtime 依赖；wall-time µs = ✗ 频率漂 30% 数字漂 30%。
219	
220	**5 阶段测量 SOP**：(0) 环境固化（1 次）driver / digest / DCGM-NVML 可读 / thermal characterization；(1) 静态闸门 ptxas -v reg/spill/shmem + SASS diff + spill 数 `grep -cE '\bLDL\b|\bSTL\b'`；(2) cycle-level clock64 microbench 单 block 单 SM N=100 median±IQR；(3) wall-time 配对 interleaved A B A B 每边 N=50 + SM clock telemetry + trimmed mean + 95% CI（<10 µs kernel 必须 batch/graph/cycle 测）；(4) e2e + nsys trace；(5) 归档 CSV 一行。
221	
222	**瓶颈三类归因**：
223	
224	| 类型 | 表征 | 攻击路径 |
225	|---|---|---|
226	| memory-bound | achieved BW / peak < 80% | cp.async stage / SMEM swizzle / TMA / weight reshuffle |
227	| compute-bound | TC issue rate < 80% peak | K_BLOCK 深化 / dequant 与 mma 重叠 |
228	| latency-bound | warp stall on dependency | 指令序列长度 / 单 PTX 替代多 ALU |
229	
230	关键避错：把 latency-bound 误判为 compute-bound。没有 ncu 时靠 ptxas + SASS + 微基对照反推。
231	
232	---
233	
234	## 6. Stage 5 — 单变量改动
235	
236	**铁律**：一次改一个轴。
237	
238	**hypothesis-test loop**：
239	1. 提出假设（明确影响哪个物理常数 / traffic / latency）
240	2. 算预期收益（用 cost model 算 ΔT_LB 或 Δ instruction count）
241	3. 改（一个变量）
242	4. 静态闸门：Python import / py_compile / ptxas -v / 必要时 cuobjdump SASS diff
243	5. **离线 sanity 闸门（[§3.6](#36-离线-sanity-闸门-quick_validate-之前必跑)）**：3 条 smoke chat，4 维通过才进下一步
244	6. 阶段 1-3 测量 SOP 验证（quick_validate A/B/A）
245	7. 实测 vs 预期；偏差 > 2× → 假设错了
246	8. 写 changelog 一行
247	
248	> 跳过 step 5 直接 step 6 = R3 类型崩溃 + 性能数字漂亮但模型坏掉的最快路径。
249	
250	**一阶 vs 二阶效应**：一阶 = cost model 等式直接出现；二阶 = 通过 pipeline / cache / issue slot 间接，没量过 stall reason 之前所有"二阶优化"都是猜。
251	
252	**5 个正交模块（CUTLASS 范式，不跨模块同时改）**：Mainloop / Epilogue / Tile Scheduler / Pipeline / Numerics。
253	
254	### 6.2 停手信号（任一触发就停）
255	
256	1. 达到 charter target SOL%
257	2. 边际收益 < 1% per round 持续 3 轮（diminishing returns）
258	3. 进一步收益需要破坏正交性
259	4. mini_bench 任一档稳态 baseline ± 1% 内连续 3 轮无突破
260	5. ncu / nsys 显示 critical path 已不在 GEMM（attention / dispatch / memcpy 主导）
261	
262	**任一触发 = 把 attention sparse / spec decoding scope 还给上游 owner，不再开新 GEMM 轮次**。
263	
264	当前（2026-05-11，post R-blog-tile-v3）：**#1 已触发**（近 4 轮 R-marlin-fp32reduce / R-b12x-bucket64 / R-blog-tile-v2 / R-blog-tile-v3 无突破）。
265	
266	---
267	
268	## 7. Stage 6 — 验证 + Lock-in
269	
270	**6 项验证**（任一不过 → 不上线）：
271	1. **离线 sanity（[§3.6](#36-离线-sanity-闸门-quick_validate-之前必跑) smoke chat 3 条）**
272	2. **quick_validate A/B/A interleave**：≥ 3 baseline + ≥ 2 patch，bs=8 / bs=16 / bs=32 / decode_single / prefill 五指标全过；**≥ 1% 改进 + SNR ≥ 3×**
273	3. **数值正确性**：fp32 reference 比 max abs / rel / cos_sim；FP4 用 ULP 标准
274	4. **cuda graph 兼容**：EAGLE draft graph capture 不卡死
275	5. **autotune cache**：key 命中率 + miss fallback 不崩
276	6. **长稳**：quick_validate 连跑 3 次数字稳定，无热降频抖动 / 无 NaN
277	
278	以 `bench/quick_validate.sh` 作为性能收益的**唯一最终评估标准**。不用 `mini_bench.sh` / `toolkit/bench_serving.sh` 作通过/否决依据。
279

282	## 8. Stage 7 — Deploy + Monitor
283	
284	性能 CI：固定 shape set 的 nightly bench (`bench/quick_validate.sh`)，CSV + control chart (mean ± 3σ) 漂移检测。CI 报警 → 回 Stage 4 重做归因。

288	## 9. 业界单条最关键沉淀
289	
290	> 版本演化的判定准则不是 speedup 数字，而是上一版瓶颈模型是否仍成立
291	
292	来自 FA v1→v4、CUTLASS 4.x 代际、Marlin → Machete 三独立证据。SOAR 当前 Marlin (M≤48) + CUTLASS (M>48) 二级 dispatch 是 archetypal 渐进路径。是否切下一代 kernel 看 sm_120 NVFP4 BlockScaled mainloop 模型是否还成立，不看 5% speedup。
293	
294	---
295	
296	## 10. 反模式 catalog
297	
298	**调研期**：不画 roofline 直接动手；没有 reference baseline；一次改多个变量；只看 wall-clock 不看 kernel metric；照抄 commit 不验证假设；优化非 critical path；把别人硬件数字当"实证"。
299	
300	**测量期（容器云特有）**：单次跑就报数字；用 wall-time 比指令数变化；没排除冷启动 / JIT；邻居偷 HBM/PCIe；DVFS sticky；测量本身扰动测量；launch overhead 主导（<10 µs kernel 30% 是 launch）；跨容器 runner 切换；报数不报分布。
301	
302	**架构层**：occupancy 越高越好（Volkov GTC 2010 证伪）；autotune 当万能药；混淆 numerical regression 与 perf regression；tunable 范围大 budget 不够。
303	
304	**Phantom win 5 patterns**（关键，外部引用）：
305	
306	1. **kernel-isolation microbench → 推 e2e 收益**（R-b12x-prefill 教训）：bench 完全脱离 production stream / cache / memory pressure。bench std_o M=2048 b12x 1.78× kernel 加速，e2e S1 反退化 +19.9%。**任何 dispatch 改动必须 mini_bench S1/S8/Smax 三档全胜才能进 quick_validate**。见 [dead-ends.md §P](dead-ends.md)。
307	2. **microbench timing 通过 = kernel 正确**（R-blog-tile-v2 教训）：参数 tweak 拿微基 10-16% 增益 + σ < 1µs，下一次独立 launch 触发 `illegal memory access`（kernel 越界写 async 报出）。**timing 漂亮的"巨胜"通常是 phantom**。新 kernel 参数必须：(a) bit-exact vs upstream-validated；(b) microbench 后立刻 launch sentinel kernel；(c) 跨多 (shape, M) sweep 无 cascade fail。参数 tweak 上限通常 5%，10%+ 通常是算法改动或 phantom。见 [dead-ends.md §Q](dead-ends.md)。
308	3. **dispatch boundary 抖动**：microbench 全胜 e2e mini_bench S1 退化 → 三档任一退化 ≥ 0.5% 即刻 ROLLBACK。
309	4. **ad-hoc Marlin (N_BLOCKS, K_BLOCKS, NUM_THREADS) 组合**：模板能编译但非 upstream-validated → 默认 unsafe。
310	5. **窄信号 e2e ROI 边际**：单 shape × 单 M kernel +9% gain 孤立点 → e2e ROI ≤ 1.5% 且 §6.2 触发 → NOT PATCHED。
311

314	## 11. 工具分级（容器云能用的）
315	
316	**总能 work**：ptxas `-v`（reg / spill / shmem）；`cuobjdump --dump-sass / --dump-resource-usage / --list-elf`；`nvdisasm --print-life-ranges`；多 trial + 中心统计量 + IQR。
317	
318	**大概率 work（有前提）**：nsys timeline duration（容器允许 ptrace）；clock64 cycle 测量；DCGM telemetry overlay（NVML 在容器可读）；`cudaFuncGetAttributes` + ncu_occupancy Python API（profiling 锁了也能调）；CUTLASS profiler `--enable-best-kernel-for-fixed-shape`。
319	
320	**Conditional**：A/B 配对绝对值比较；CUDA Graph 整体 event timing；差分 microbench 推断 production metric。
321	
322	**永久不可用（已死）**：ncu hardware counter（SKU 锁）；CUPTI PC Sampling / SASS metrics（Blackwell 整族砍）；CUPTI Range Profiler；GPUscout / Zymtrace / 任何走 PerfWorks；`nvidia-smi` 锁频（容器无 user_4813494d）。
323	
324	详见 [`dead-ends.md`](dead-ends.md)。

23	|---|---|

35	## B. Pre-patch 自查
36

38	
39	- [ ] 候选不在 §A-§R 任一 dead-end 重复 → 否则停手
40	- [ ] 不属于 §4.1 REJECTED rows → 否则需新 attribute 理由
41	- [ ] 不踩 `microbench timing ≠ correctness`（§Q） = 准备 sentinel check
42	- [ ] 不踩 `microbench win ≠ e2e win`（§P R-b12x-prefill） = 准备 mini_bench 三档 gate
43	
44	### B.2 §6.2 停手信号自查（[methodology.md §6.2](methodology.md) / [roadmap.md §6.2](roadmap.md)）
45	
46	- [ ] mini_bench 任一档 baseline ± 1% 内连续 < 3 轮无突破（>=3 = 触发停手，需 §6.2 reset 才能开新攻击）
47	- [ ] 候选 6 问中 "5 项验证能否过" 不全 "高风险"
48	- [ ] ncu/nsys 显示 critical path 仍在 GEMM（非 attention / dispatch / memcpy 主导）
49	
50	**任一红 → 不开新轮**。当前（2026-05-11）：§6.2 #1 已触发，新攻击需有新 ROI 论证。
51	
52	### B.3 影响范围 → validation gate 映射
53	
54	| 改动类型 | 必走 gate | 跳过条件 |
55	|---|---|---|
56	| **Python only（dispatch 不变）** | smoke → quick_validate A/B/A → full_eval | 无 |
57	| **Python dispatch / 路径切换**（`*_OVERRIDE` / `*_MAX_M` / `_M_BUCKETS` / `marlin_upper`） | smoke → numerics → **mini_bench S1/S8/Smax 三档** → quick_validate → full_eval | 无（§3.5.1 硬规则） |
58	| **env-var only**（`SGLANG_*_FORCE_*`） | smoke → quick_validate A/B/A | 仅 sweep / 不上线时跳 full_eval |
59	| **sgl-kernel csrc + .so 替换** | smoke → **numerics bit-exact / sentinel** → quick_validate → mini_bench 三档（若影响 dispatch）→ full_eval | 无 |
60	| **flashinfer csrc + JIT/AOT 替换** | 同上 + JIT rebuild 协议 | 无 |
61

63	
64	## C+D. Patch 开发 + Validation gate（5 道闸）
65	
66	**.so 替换硬规则**：(1) 备份 `outputs/so_backups/<TS>__<src>__<sha12>/` 保留旧 `.so` + `meta.json`（original_path / md5 / sha256 / cuobjdump_sm_tags / source_commit / reason）；(2) [so-replacements.md](so-replacements.md) 追加日志行；(3) 严禁 `cp` 覆盖未备份的 `.so`。sgl-kernel 增量 rebuild + flashinfer JIT/AOT 命令参 CLAUDE.md / [todo.md §4](todo.md)。
67	
68	**D.1 Smoke（永远跑）**：3 条简单 chat 都说人话 → PASS。任一乱码 → ROLLBACK，不管后续 bench。详见 [methodology.md §3.6](methodology.md)。
69	
70	**D.2 Numerics（kernel csrc 改动必跑）**：
71	
72	| 改动 | check |
73	|---|---|
74	| 新 Marlin tile 组合 | bit-exact vs upstream-validated tile OR cos_sim ≥ 0.9999 |
75	| Marlin / b12x 路径切换 | reference (CUTLASS unscaled) cos_sim ≥ 0.99 |
76	| 改 reduce dtype / quant scale | 全 batch chat 5 句对比 baseline |
77	| 加新 CUTLASS tile | reference cos_sim ≥ 0.99 + sentinel check |
78	
79	**Sentinel check**（[dead-ends.md §Q](dead-ends.md)）：每个 trial 后 launch trivial kernel (`torch.zeros(64).fill_(1.0)` + `synchronize()`)，若报 illegal memory access → 前一次 timing 是 phantom，整组作废。参考 `bench/kernels/marlin_tile_sweep.py:60-71`。
80	
81	**D.3 quick_validate A/B/A（kernel csrc / Python dispatch 必跑）**：`bash bench/quick_validate.sh`。A/B/A = baseline → patch → baseline 三次（每 30+ trials）。判据：patch vs baseline 每档 ≥ 1% 正向 OR 中性 ± 0.5%；SNR (B-A) ≥ 3× σ_A；baseline 复跑 A vs A' 差 < 1%。
82	
83	**D.4 mini_bench S1/S8/Smax 三档（dispatch / 路径切换必跑）**：`bash bench/mini_bench.sh`。硬规则（[methodology.md §3.5.1](methodology.md)）：每档 ≤ baseline × 1.005。任一档退化 ≥ 0.5% → ROLLBACK。R-b12x-prefill / R-b12x-bucket64 都是 quick_validate 微基胜，三档失败（dispatch boundary 抖动）→ **dispatch 改动不过三档 = phantom win**。
84	
85	**D.5 full_eval（lock-in 前必跑）**：`bash toolkit/bench_serving.sh http://127.0.0.1:30000` 或 `eval/run_public_eval_full.sh`。`ori_acc` ≥ baseline - 0.05pp；`duration` ≤ baseline × 1.005；中英 chat 各 2 句 spot-check。任一红 → ROLLBACK。
86

89	## E. Lock-in 后处理
90	
91	PASS 全部闸门后：(1) [changelog.md](changelog.md) 追加一行（含 hypothesis / predicted / measured / smoke / 各 gate / artifact / PASS）；(2) [roadmap.md §3](roadmap.md) 加 lock-in 行（若新生产路径）；(3) [todo.md §4](todo.md) 标 ✅ + commit；(4) commit message 短祈使 + 数字。严禁 commit 未备份的 `.so` 替换。
92	
93	## F. Rollback SOP
94	
95	(1) `.so` 从 `outputs/so_backups/...` 回滚 + verify md5；(2) source `git checkout --`；(3) 失败 microbench JSON 改名 `*_dead-end_*.json` 保留；(4) [dead-ends.md](dead-ends.md) 新增章节（假设 / 已回滚 patch / 数据 / 根因 / 弃用清单 / artifact）；(5) [roadmap.md §4.1](roadmap.md) REJECTED 加 row；(6) [todo.md §4](todo.md) 标 ❌ + dead-ends 引用。
96

98	
99	## G. Phantom win pattern（看到立刻拒）
100	
101	| Pattern | 信号 | 触发 |
102	|---|---|---|
103	| **kernel 越界写** | σ < 1µs / microbench 巨胜 10%+ / 后续 CUDA op illegal memory access | sentinel 失败 → 整组作废 |
104	| **dispatch boundary 抖动** | microbench 全胜 e2e mini_bench S1 退化 | mini_bench 三档任一退化 ≥ 0.5% → ROLLBACK |
105	| **ad-hoc Marlin tuple** | 模板能编译但非 upstream-validated | 不在 vLLM marlin commit history → unsafe |
106	| **timing 反常巨大 >10%** | 单参数 tweak 拿算法级增益 | 警惕 phantom，必走 sentinel + numerics + 多 shape sweep |
107	| **窄信号 e2e ROI 边际** | 单 shape × 单 M kernel +9% 孤立点 | e2e ROI ≤ 1.5% 且 §6.2 已触发 → NOT PATCHED |
108	
109	详见 [dead-ends.md §P / §Q](dead-ends.md) 与 [methodology.md §10](methodology.md)。

119	- [ ] ncu / nsys 显示 critical path 已不在 GEMM（attention / dispatch / memcpy 主导）→ ⚠ 触发

31	/*! \file
32	    \brief A GEMM example using CUTLASS for the NVIDIA Blackwell SM120 architecture.
33	
34	    This example demonstrates a simple way to instantiate and run a narrow precision blockscaled sparse GEMM on the NVIDIA Blackwell SM120 architecture.
35	    This kernel is optimized for the GeForce RTX 50 series GPUs.
36	
37	    The Blackwell SM120 CUTLASS kernel uses the new Block Scaled Sparse Tensor Core MMA Instructions:
38	      * mma.sync.aligned.kind::mxf4nvf4.sp::ordered_metadata.block_scale.
39	    Please see more detail in https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution.
40	
41	    The kernel leverages:
42	    1. Warp-Specialized persistent kernel design that supports cooperative scheduler introduced in Hopper.
43	    2. The new SW controlled dynamic scheduler based on cluster launch control (See https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution).
44	    3. Block Scaled Sparse Tensor Core MMA Instructions
45	
46	    Note that GeForce RTX 50 series GPUs do not support:
47	    1. Multicast feature of TMA load. Cluster shape has to be 1x1x1.
48	    2. Dynamic datatypes.
49	
50	    Usage:
51	      $ ./examples/80_blackwell_geforce_sparse_gemm/80b_blackwell_geforce_nvfp4_nvfp4_sparse_gemm --m=2048 --n=2048 --k=2048
52	*/

194	// Command line options parsing
195	struct Options {
196	  bool help;
197	  float alpha, beta;
198	  int iterations;
199	  int m, n, k;
200	  Options():
201	    help(false),
202	    m(1024), n(1024), k(1024),
203	    alpha(1.f), beta(0.f),
204	    iterations(10)
205	  { }
206	  // Parses the command line
207	  void parse(int argc, char const **args) {
208	    cutlass::CommandLine cmd(argc, args);
209	    if (cmd.check_cmd_line_flag("help")) {
210	      help = true;
211	      return;
212	    }
213	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("m", m);
214	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("n", n);
215	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("k", k);
216	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("alpha", alpha, 1.f);
217	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("beta", beta, 0.f);
218	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("iterations", iterations);
219	  }
220	  /// Prints the usage statement.
221	  std::ostream & print_usage(std::ostream &out) const {
222	    out << "80b_blackwell_geforce_nvfp4_nvfp4_sparse_gemm\n\n"
223	      << "  Blackwell MXFP8 Sparse GEMM is a warp specialized kernel.\n\n"
224	      << "Options:\n\n"
225	      << "  --help                      If specified, displays this usage statement\n\n"
226	      << "  --m=<int>                   Sets the M extent of the GEMM\n"
227	      << "  --n=<int>                   Sets the N extent of the GEMM\n"
228	      << "  --k=<int>                   Sets the K extent of the GEMM\n"
229	      << "  --alpha=<f32>               Epilogue scalar alpha\n"
230	      << "  --beta=<f32>                Epilogue scalar beta\n\n"
231	      << "  --iterations=<int>          Number of profiling iterations to perform.\n\n";
232	    out << "\n\nExamples:\n\n"
233	      << "$ " << "./examples/80_blackwell_geforce_sparse_gemm/80b_blackwell_geforce_nvfp4_nvfp4_sparse_gemm" << " --m=1024 --n=512 --k=1024 --alpha=2 --beta=0.707 \n\n";
234	    return out;
235	  }
236	  /// Compute performance in GFLOP/s
237	  double gflops(double runtime_s) const
238	  {
239	    // Two flops per multiply-add
240	    uint64_t flop = uint64_t(2) * m * n * k;
241	    double gflop = double(flop) / double(1.0e9);
242	    return gflop / runtime_s;
243	  }
244	};

266	/// Helper to initialize a block of device data
267	template <typename Element, typename Layout>
268	bool initialize_block(
269	  cutlass::TensorView<Element, Layout> view,
270	  uint64_t seed) {
271	  double scope_max, scope_min;
272	  constexpr int bits_input = cutlass::sizeof_bits<Element>::value;
273	  if constexpr (bits_input == 1) {
274	    scope_max = 2;
275	    scope_min = 0;
276	  }
277	  else if constexpr (bits_input <= 6) {
278	    scope_max = 2;
279	    scope_min = -2;
280	  }
281	  else if constexpr (bits_input <= 8) {
282	    if constexpr (cute::is_same_v<Element, cutlass::float_ue8m0_t>) {
283	      scope_max = 4;
284	      scope_min = 1;
285	    }
286	    else {
287	      scope_max = 1;
288	      scope_min = -1;
289	    }
290	  }
291	  else{
292	    scope_max = 4;
293	    scope_min = -4;
294	  }
295	  cutlass::reference::host::TensorFillRandomUniform(
296	    view, seed, scope_max, scope_min, 0);
297	
298	  return true;
299	}
300	/// Initialize blocks that released to sparse Matrix A and its metadata E
301	bool initialize_sparse_blocks(const Options &options) {
302	  auto workload = make_shape(options.m,
303	                             options.n,
304	                             options.k,
305	                             1);
306	  stride_A = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, {options.m, options.k, 1});
307	  /// Alias SparseConfig and Compressor
308	  using SparseConfig = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::SparseConfig;
309	  using CompressorUtility = cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressorUtility<
310	                              cute::Shape<int, int, int, int>,
311	                              ElementA::DataType,
312	                              LayoutATag,
313	                              SparseConfig>;
314	  using CompressorKernel = cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressor<
315	                              cute::Shape<int, int, int, int>,
316	                              ElementA::DataType,
317	                              LayoutATag,
318	                              SparseConfig,
319	                              cutlass::arch::Sm120>;
320	  using Compressor = cutlass::transform::device::TransformUniversalAdapter<CompressorKernel>;
321	  /// Declare compressor_utility to randomly fill zero in Matrix A to match sparsity needs
322	  CompressorUtility compressor_utility(workload, stride_A);
323	  // Aligned M K dimension size for A and E
324	  int aligned_m_e = compressor_utility.get_metadata_m_physical();
325	  int aligned_k_e = compressor_utility.get_metadata_k_physical();
326	  int aligned_m_a = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_m_physical();
327	  int aligned_k_a = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_k_physical();
328	  /// Layout A and E
329	  layout_A = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(workload);
330	  layout_E = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(workload);
331	
332	  block_A.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(aligned_m_a * aligned_k_a));
333	  block_E.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(aligned_m_e * aligned_k_e));
334	  block_A_Decompressed.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(options.m * options.k));
335	  initialize_block(block_A_Decompressed.host_view(), seed + 2020);
336	  compressor_utility.structure_sparse_zero_mask_fill(
337	          block_A_Decompressed.host_data(), static_cast<int>(seed + 2021));
338	  block_A_Decompressed.sync_device();
339	
340	  /// Use compressor kernel to generate compressed Matrix A and E
341	  cutlass::Status status { cutlass::Status::kSuccess };
342	  cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo hw_info;
343	  hw_info.device_id = 0;
344	  hw_info.sm_count = cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo::query_device_multiprocessor_count(hw_info.device_id);
345	  typename Compressor::Arguments arguments{
346	    {options.m, options.n, options.k, 1},
347	    {block_A_Decompressed.device_data(),
348	      stride_A,
349	      block_A.device_data(),
350	      block_E.device_data()},
351	    {hw_info}
352	  };
353	
354	  // Compress A and E
355	  Compressor compressor_op;
356	  size_t workspace_size = Compressor::get_workspace_size(arguments);
357	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
358	  status = compressor_op.can_implement(arguments);
359	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
360	    return false;
361	  }
362	
363	  status = compressor_op.initialize(arguments, workspace.get());
364	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
365	    return false;
366	  }
367	
368	  status = compressor_op.run();
369	  auto result = cudaDeviceSynchronize();
370	  if (result != cudaSuccess) {
371	    return false;
372	  }
373	
374	  block_A.sync_host();
375	  block_E.sync_host();
376	  return true;
377	}
378	/// Initialize operands to be used in the GEMM and reference GEMM
379	bool initialize(const Options &options) {
380	  using namespace cute;
381	
382	  // Initial A, E(metadata) and A_compressed blocks
383	  if(!initialize_sparse_blocks(options)) return false;
384	
385	  // Define B, C and D blocks
386	  using Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig;
387	  stride_B = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideB{}, {options.n, options.k, 1});
388	  stride_C = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideC{}, {options.m, options.n, 1});
389	  stride_D = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideD{}, {options.m, options.n, 1});
390	  layout_B = make_layout(make_shape(options.n, options.k, 1), stride_B);
391	  layout_C = make_layout(make_shape(options.m, options.n, 1), stride_C);
392	  layout_D = make_layout(make_shape(options.m, options.n, 1), stride_D);
393	  layout_SFD = SfdOutputCfg::tile_atom_to_shape_SFD(cute::make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.k, 1));
394	  // Define SFA and SFB tensors layouts
395	  layout_SFA = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(cute::make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.k, 1));
396	  layout_SFB = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFB(cute::make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.k, 1));
397	  block_B.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_B)));
398	  block_C.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_C)));
399	  block_D.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_D)));
400	  block_SFD.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(filter_zeros(layout_SFD))));
401	  block_reference_D.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_D)));
402	  block_reference_SFD.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(filter_zeros(layout_SFD))));
403	  block_Normconst.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(1));
404	  block_SFA.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(filter_zeros(layout_SFA))));
405	  block_SFB.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(filter_zeros(layout_SFB))));
406	  initialize_block(block_B.host_view(), seed + 2022);
407	  initialize_block(block_C.host_view(), seed + 2023);
408	  initialize_block(block_SFA.host_view(), seed + 2024);
409	  initialize_block(block_SFB.host_view(), seed + 2025);
410	  block_Normconst.at(cutlass::make_Coord(0)) = 2;
411	  block_B.sync_device();
412	  block_C.sync_device();
413	  block_SFA.sync_device();
414	  block_SFB.sync_device();
415	  block_SFD.sync_device();
416	  block_Normconst.sync_device();
417	  return true;
418	}
419	// Populates a Gemm::Arguments structure from the given commandline options
420	typename Gemm::Arguments args_from_options(const Options &options)
421	{
422	  typename Gemm::Arguments arguments {
423	    cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode::kGemm,
424	    {options.m, options.n, options.k, 1},
425	    { // Mainloop arguments
426	      block_A.device_data(), layout_A,
427	      block_B.device_data(), stride_B,
428	      block_E.device_data(), layout_E,
429	      block_SFA.device_data(), layout_SFA,
430	      block_SFB.device_data(), layout_SFB
431	    },
432	    { // Epilogue arguments
433	      {options.alpha, options.beta},
434	      block_C.device_data(), stride_C,
435	      block_D.device_data(), stride_D
436	    }
437	  };
438	  arguments.epilogue.thread.block_scale_factor_ptr = block_SFD.device_data();
439	  arguments.epilogue.thread.norm_constant_ptr      = block_Normconst.device_data();
440	  return arguments;
441	}
442	bool verify(const Options &options) {
443	  using namespace cute;
444	  // Create the arguments for host reference implementation
445	  Tensor tensor_A = make_tensor(make_iterator(block_A_Decompressed.host_data()), layout_A);
446	  Tensor tensor_SFA = make_tensor(block_SFA.host_data(), layout_SFA);
447	  Tensor tensor_B = make_tensor(make_iterator(block_B.host_data()), layout_B);
448	  Tensor tensor_SFB = make_tensor(block_SFB.host_data(), layout_SFB);
449	  Tensor tensor_E = make_tensor(make_iterator(block_E.host_data()), layout_E);
450	
451	  cutlass::reference::host::GettBlockScalingMainloopParams<
452	      ElementAccumulator,                 // ElementAccumulator
453	      decltype(tensor_A),                 // TensorA
454	      decltype(tensor_SFA),               // TensorSfA
455	      decltype(tensor_B),                 // TensorB
456	      decltype(tensor_SFB)                // TensorSfB
457	    > mainloop_params{tensor_A, tensor_SFA, tensor_B, tensor_SFB};
458	  auto tensor_C = cute::make_tensor(make_iterator(block_C.host_data()), layout_C);
459	  auto tensor_D = cute::make_tensor(make_iterator(block_reference_D.host_data()), layout_D);
460	  auto tensor_SFD = cute::make_tensor(block_reference_SFD.host_data(), layout_SFD);
461	
462	  cutlass::reference::host::GettBlockScalingEpilogueParams<
463	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementScalar
464	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementAccumulator
465	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementCompute
466	      decltype(tensor_C),                   // TensorC
467	      decltype(tensor_D),                   // TensorD
468	      decltype(tensor_SFD),                 // TensorSfD
469	      cute::Int<outputVectorSize>,
470	      cutlass::reference::host::SfStrategy::SfDGen
471	    > epilogue_params{options.alpha, options.beta, tensor_C, tensor_D, tensor_SFD, block_Normconst.at(cutlass::make_Coord(0))};
472	  cutlass::reference::host::Gemm3x(mainloop_params, epilogue_params);
473	  // Comparison
474	  block_D.sync_host();
475	
476	  bool passed = cutlass::reference::host::TensorEquals(block_reference_D.host_view(), block_reference_D.host_view());
477	  passed &= (cutlass::reference::host::TensorNorm(block_reference_D.host_view()) > 0);
478	  passed &= (cutlass::reference::host::TensorNorm(block_D.host_view()) > 0);
479	  return passed;
480	}
481	/// Execute a given example GEMM computation
482	template <typename Gemm>
483	int run(Options &options)
484	{
485	  // Initialization
486	  if(!initialize(options))
487	  {
488	    std::cerr << " Initialization failed! " << std::endl;
489	    exit(-1);
490	  }
491	
492	  // Instantiate CUTLASS kernel depending on templates
493	  Gemm gemm;
494	  // Create a structure of gemm kernel arguments suitable for invoking an instance of Gemm
495	  auto arguments = args_from_options(options);
496	  // Using the arguments, query for extra workspace required for matrix multiplication computation
497	  size_t workspace_size = Gemm::get_workspace_size(arguments);
498	  // Allocate workspace memory
499	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
500	  // Check if the problem size is supported or not
501	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.can_implement(arguments));
502	  // Initialize CUTLASS kernel with arguments and workspace pointer
503	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
504	  // Correctness / Warmup iteration
505	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
506	  cudaDeviceSynchronize();
507	  // Check if output from CUTLASS kernel and reference kernel are equal or not
508	  Result result;
509	  result.passed = verify(options);
510	  std::cout << "  Disposition: " << (result.passed ? "Passed" : "Failed") << std::endl;
511	  if (!result.passed) {
512	    exit(-1);
513	  }
514	  // Run profiling loop
515	  if (options.iterations > 0)
516	  {
517	    GpuTimer timer;
518	    timer.start();
519	    for (int iter = 0; iter < options.iterations; ++iter) {
520	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
521	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
522	    }
523	    timer.stop();
524	    // Compute average runtime and GFLOPs.
525	    float elapsed_ms = timer.elapsed_millis();
526	    result.avg_runtime_ms = double(elapsed_ms) / double(options.iterations);
527	    result.gflops = options.gflops(result.avg_runtime_ms / 1000.0);
528	    std::cout << "  Problem Size: " << options.m << 'x' << options.n << 'x' << options.k << std::endl;
529	    std::cout << "  Avg runtime: " << result.avg_runtime_ms << " ms" << std::endl;
530	    std::cout << "  GFLOPS: " << result.gflops << std::endl;
531	  }
532	  return 0;
533	}

550	    // Returning zero so this test passes on older Toolkits. Its actions are no-op.
551	    return 0;
552	  }
553	#endif
554	  cudaDeviceProp props;

556	  CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&current_device_id));
557

559	
560	  if (!(props.major == 12 && (props.minor == 0 || props.minor == 1))) {
561	    std::cerr << "This example requires a GPU of NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture (compute capability 120 or 121)." << std::endl;
562	    return 0;
563	  }
564	  //
565	  // Parse options
566	  //

568	  options.parse(argc, args);

571	    return 0;
572	  }
573	  //
574	  // Evaluate CUTLASS kernels
575	  //
576	#if defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM120_SUPPORTED) || defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM121_SUPPORTED)
577	  run<Gemm>(options);
578	#endif // defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM120_SUPPORTED) || defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM121_SUPPORTED)
579	  return 0;
580	}

31	/*! \file
32	    \brief A GEMM example using CUTLASS for the NVIDIA Blackwell SM120 architecture.
33	
34	    This example demonstrates a simple way to instantiate and run a narrow precision blockscaled sparse GEMM on the NVIDIA Blackwell SM120 architecture.
35	    This kernel is optimized for the GeForce RTX 50 series GPUs.
36	
37	    The Blackwell SM120 CUTLASS kernel uses the new Block Scaled Sparse Tensor Core MMA Instructions:
38	      * mma.sync.aligned.kind::mxf8f6f4.sp::ordered_metadata.block_scale.
39	    Please see more detail in https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution.
40	
41	    The kernel leverages:
42	    1. Warp-Specialized persistent kernel design that supports cooperative scheduler introduced in Hopper.
43	    2. The new SW controlled dynamic scheduler based on cluster launch control (See https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution).
44	    3. Block Scaled Sparse Tensor Core MMA Instructions
45	
46	    Note that GeForce RTX 50 series GPUs do not support:
47	    1. Multicast feature of TMA load. Cluster shape has to be 1x1x1.
48	    2. Dynamic datatypes.
49	
50	    Usage:
51	      $ ./examples/80_blackwell_geforce_sparse_gemm/80a_blackwell_geforce_mxfp8_bf16_sparse_gemm --m=2048 --n=2048 --k=2048
52	*/
