85	// A matrix configuration
86	using         ElementA    = cutlass::mx_float8_t<cutlass::float_e4m3_t>;     // Element type for A matrix operand
87	using         LayoutATag  = cutlass::layout::RowMajor;                       // Layout type for A matrix operand
88	constexpr int AlignmentA  = 32;                                              // Memory access granularity/alignment of A matrix in units of elements (up to 16 bytes)
89	// B matrix configuration
90	using         ElementB    = cutlass::mx_float8_t<cutlass::float_e4m3_t>;     // Element type for B matrix operand
91	using         LayoutBTag  = cutlass::layout::ColumnMajor;                    // Layout type for B matrix operand
92	constexpr int AlignmentB  = 16;                                              // Memory access granularity/alignment of B matrix in units of elements (up to 16 bytes)
93	// C/D matrix configuration
94	using         ElementD    = cutlass::bfloat16_t;                             // Element type for D matrix operand
95	using         ElementC    = cutlass::bfloat16_t;                             // Element type for C matrix operand
96	using         LayoutCTag  = cutlass::layout::RowMajor;                       // Layout type for C matrix operand
97	using         LayoutDTag  = cutlass::layout::RowMajor;                       // Layout type for D matrix operand
98	constexpr int AlignmentD  = 128 / cutlass::sizeof_bits<ElementD>::value;     // Memory access granularity/alignment of C matrix in units of elements (up to 16 bytes)
99	constexpr int AlignmentC  = 128 / cutlass::sizeof_bits<ElementC>::value;     // Memory access granularity/alignment of C matrix in units of elements (up to 16 bytes)
100	// E matrix configuration. Note, E is used to represent metadata tensor.
101	using         ElementE    = uint8_t;                                         // Element type for E matrix operand
102	// Kernel functional config
103	using ElementAccumulator  = float;                                           // Element type for internal accumulation
104	using ArchTag             = cutlass::arch::Sm120;                            // Tag indicating the minimum SM that supports the intended feature
105	using OperatorClass       = cutlass::arch::OpClassBlockScaledSparseTensorOp; // Operator class tag
106	using KernelScheduleType =  cutlass::gemm::KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecializedMxf8f6f4Acc2x4Sm120;   // Kernel schedule policy
107	// Kernel Perf config
108	using ThreadBlockShape    = Shape<_128,_128,_256>;                           // Threadblock's tile size
109	using ClusterShape        = Shape<_1,_1,_1>;                                 // Shape of the threadblocks in a cluster
110	using CollectiveEpilogue = typename cutlass::epilogue::collective::CollectiveBuilder<
111	    ArchTag, OperatorClass,
112	    ThreadBlockShape, ClusterShape,
113	    cutlass::epilogue::collective::EpilogueTileAuto,
114	    ElementAccumulator, ElementAccumulator,
115	    ElementC, LayoutCTag, AlignmentC,
116	    ElementD, LayoutDTag, AlignmentD,
117	    cutlass::epilogue::collective::EpilogueScheduleAuto                      // Epilogue schedule policy
118	  >::CollectiveOp;
119	using CollectiveMainloop = typename cutlass::gemm::collective::CollectiveBuilder<
120	    ArchTag, OperatorClass,
121	    ElementA, LayoutATag, AlignmentA,
122	    ElementB, LayoutBTag, AlignmentB,
123	    ElementAccumulator,
124	    ThreadBlockShape, ClusterShape,
125	    cutlass::gemm::collective::StageCountAutoCarveout<static_cast<int>(sizeof(typename CollectiveEpilogue::SharedStorage))>,
126	    KernelScheduleType                                                       // Mainloop schedule policy
127	  >::CollectiveOp;
128	using GemmKernel = cutlass::gemm::kernel::GemmUniversal<
129	    Shape<int,int,int,int>,                                                  // Indicates ProblemShape
130	    CollectiveMainloop,
131	    CollectiveEpilogue,
132	    void>;
133	using Gemm = cutlass::gemm::device::GemmUniversalAdapter<GemmKernel>;
134	// Reference device GEMM implementation type
135	using StrideA   = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::StrideA;
136	using LayoutA   = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::LayoutA;
137	using LayoutSFA = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::LayoutSFA;
138	using StrideB   = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::StrideB;
139	using LayoutB   = decltype(cute::make_layout(make_shape(0,0,0), StrideB{}));
140	using LayoutSFB = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::LayoutSFB;
141	using StrideC   = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::StrideC;
142	using LayoutC   = decltype(cute::make_layout(make_shape(0,0,0), StrideC{}));

144	using LayoutD   = decltype(cute::make_layout(make_shape(0,0,0), StrideD{}));
145	using LayoutE   = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::LayoutE;

152	LayoutSFA layout_SFA;

162	// The HostTensors are only used for allocating memory on host and device, and transferring data between host and device

165	cutlass::HostTensor<ElementA::DataType, cutlass::layout::PackedVectorLayout> block_A_Decompressed;
166	cutlass::HostTensor<ElementE, cutlass::layout::PackedVectorLayout> block_E;
167	cutlass::HostTensor<ElementA::ScaleFactorType, cutlass::layout::PackedVectorLayout> block_SFA;
168	cutlass::HostTensor<ElementB::DataType, cutlass::layout::PackedVectorLayout> block_B;
169	cutlass::HostTensor<ElementB::ScaleFactorType, cutlass::layout::PackedVectorLayout> block_SFB;
170	cutlass::HostTensor<ElementC, cutlass::layout::PackedVectorLayout> block_C;
171	// Output Tensor
172	cutlass::HostTensor<ElementD, cutlass::layout::PackedVectorLayout> block_D;

183	// Command line options parsing
184	struct Options {
185	  bool help;
186	  float alpha, beta;
187	  int iterations;
188	  int m, n, k;
189	  Options():
190	    help(false),
191	    m(1024), n(1024), k(1024),
192	    alpha(1.f), beta(0.f),
193	    iterations(10)
194	  { }
195	  // Parses the command line
196	  void parse(int argc, char const **args) {
197	    cutlass::CommandLine cmd(argc, args);
198	    if (cmd.check_cmd_line_flag("help")) {
199	      help = true;
200	      return;
201	    }
202	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("m", m);
203	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("n", n);
204	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("k", k);
205	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("alpha", alpha, 1.f);
206	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("beta", beta, 0.f);
207	    cmd.get_cmd_line_argument("iterations", iterations);
208	  }
209	  /// Prints the usage statement.
210	  std::ostream & print_usage(std::ostream &out) const {
211	    out << "80a_blackwell_geforce_mxfp8_bf16_sparse_gemm\n\n"
212	      << "  Blackwell MXFP8 Sparse GEMM is a warp specialized kernel.\n\n"
213	      << "Options:\n\n"
214	      << "  --help                      If specified, displays this usage statement\n\n"
215	      << "  --m=<int>                   Sets the M extent of the GEMM\n"
216	      << "  --n=<int>                   Sets the N extent of the GEMM\n"
217	      << "  --k=<int>                   Sets the K extent of the GEMM\n"
218	      << "  --alpha=<f32>               Epilogue scalar alpha\n"
219	      << "  --beta=<f32>                Epilogue scalar beta\n\n"
220	      << "  --iterations=<int>          Number of profiling iterations to perform.\n\n";
221	    out << "\n\nExamples:\n\n"
222	      << "$ " << "./examples/80_blackwell_geforce_sparse_gemm/80a_blackwell_geforce_mxfp8_bf16_sparse_gemm" << " --m=1024 --n=512 --k=1024 --alpha=2 --beta=0.707 \n\n";
223	    return out;
224	  }
225	  /// Compute performance in GFLOP/s
226	  double gflops(double runtime_s) const
227	  {
228	    // Two flops per multiply-add
229	    uint64_t flop = uint64_t(2) * m * n * k;
230	    double gflop = double(flop) / double(1.0e9);
231	    return gflop / runtime_s;
232	  }
233	};
234	/// Result structure
235	struct Result
236	{
237	  double avg_runtime_ms;
238	  double gflops;
239	  cutlass::Status status;
240	  cudaError_t error;
241	  bool passed;
242	  Result(
243	    double avg_runtime_ms = 0,
244	    double gflops = 0,
245	    cutlass::Status status = cutlass::Status::kSuccess,
246	    cudaError_t error = cudaSuccess)
247	  :
248	    avg_runtime_ms(avg_runtime_ms), gflops(gflops), status(status), error(error), passed(false)
249	  {}
250	};

253	/// GEMM setup and evaluation
254	/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
255	/// Helper to initialize a block of device data
256	template <typename Element, typename Layout>
257	bool initialize_block(
258	  cutlass::TensorView<Element, Layout> view,
259	  uint64_t seed) {
260	  double scope_max, scope_min;
261	  constexpr int bits_input = cutlass::sizeof_bits<Element>::value;
262	  if constexpr (bits_input == 1) {
263	    scope_max = 2;
264	    scope_min = 0;
265	  }
266	  else if constexpr (bits_input <= 6) {
267	    scope_max = 2;
268	    scope_min = -2;
269	  }
270	  else if constexpr (bits_input <= 8) {
271	    if constexpr (cute::is_same_v<Element, cutlass::float_ue8m0_t>) {
272	      scope_max = 4;
273	      scope_min = 1;
274	    }
275	    else {
276	      scope_max = 1;
277	      scope_min = -1;
278	    }
279	  }
280	  else{
281	    scope_max = 4;
282	    scope_min = -4;
283	  }
284	  cutlass::reference::host::TensorFillRandomUniform(
285	    view, seed, scope_max, scope_min, 0);
286	
287	  return true;
288	}
289	/// Initialize blocks that released to sparse Matrix A and its metadata E
290	bool initialize_sparse_blocks(const Options &options) {
291	  auto workload = make_shape(options.m,
292	                             options.n,
293	                             options.k,
294	                             1);
295	  stride_A = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, {options.m, options.k, 1});
296	  /// Alias SparseConfig and Compressor
297	  using SparseConfig = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::SparseConfig;
298	  using CompressorUtility = cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressorUtility<
299	                              cute::Shape<int, int, int, int>,
300	                              ElementA::DataType,
301	                              LayoutATag,
302	                              SparseConfig>;
303	  using CompressorKernel = cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressor<
304	                              cute::Shape<int, int, int, int>,
305	                              ElementA::DataType,
306	                              LayoutATag,
307	                              SparseConfig,
308	                              cutlass::arch::Sm120>;
309	  using Compressor = cutlass::transform::device::TransformUniversalAdapter<CompressorKernel>;
310	  /// Declare compressor_utility to randomly fill zero in Matrix A to match sparsity needs
311	  CompressorUtility compressor_utility(workload, stride_A);
312	  // Aligned M K dimension size for A and E
313	  int aligned_m_e = compressor_utility.get_metadata_m_physical();
314	  int aligned_k_e = compressor_utility.get_metadata_k_physical();
315	  int aligned_m_a = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_m_physical();
316	  int aligned_k_a = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_k_physical();
317	  /// Layout A and E
318	  layout_A = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(workload);
319	  layout_E = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(workload);
320	
321	  block_A.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(aligned_m_a * aligned_k_a));
322	  block_E.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(aligned_m_e * aligned_k_e));
323	  block_A_Decompressed.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(options.m * options.k));
324	  initialize_block(block_A_Decompressed.host_view(), seed + 2020);
325	  compressor_utility.structure_sparse_zero_mask_fill(
326	          block_A_Decompressed.host_data(), static_cast<int>(seed + 2021));
327	  block_A_Decompressed.sync_device();
328	
329	  /// Use compressor kernel to generate compressed Matrix A and E
330	  cutlass::Status status { cutlass::Status::kSuccess };
331	  cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo hw_info;
332	  hw_info.device_id = 0;
333	  hw_info.sm_count = cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo::query_device_multiprocessor_count(hw_info.device_id);
334	  typename Compressor::Arguments arguments{
335	    {options.m, options.n, options.k, 1},
336	    {block_A_Decompressed.device_data(),
337	      stride_A,
338	      block_A.device_data(),
339	      block_E.device_data()},
340	    {hw_info}
341	  };
342	
343	  // Compress A and E
344	  Compressor compressor_op;
345	  size_t workspace_size = Compressor::get_workspace_size(arguments);
346	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
347	  status = compressor_op.can_implement(arguments);
348	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
349	    return false;
350	  }
351	
352	  status = compressor_op.initialize(arguments, workspace.get());
353	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
354	    return false;
355	  }
356	
357	  status = compressor_op.run();
358	  auto result = cudaDeviceSynchronize();
359	  if (result != cudaSuccess) {
360	    return false;
361	  }
362	
363	  block_A.sync_host();
364	  block_E.sync_host();
365	  return true;
366	}
367	/// Initialize operands to be used in the GEMM and reference GEMM
368	bool initialize(const Options &options) {
369	  using namespace cute;
370	
371	  // Initial A, E(metadata) and A_compressed blocks
372	  if(!initialize_sparse_blocks(options)) return false;
373	
374	  // Define B, C and D blocks
375	  using Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig;
376	  stride_B = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideB{}, {options.n, options.k, 1});
377	  stride_C = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideC{}, {options.m, options.n, 1});
378	  stride_D = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideD{}, {options.m, options.n, 1});
379	  layout_B = make_layout(make_shape(options.n, options.k, 1), stride_B);
380	  layout_C = make_layout(make_shape(options.m, options.n, 1), stride_C);
381	  layout_D = make_layout(make_shape(options.m, options.n, 1), stride_D);
382	  // Define SFA and SFB tensors layouts
383	  layout_SFA = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(cute::make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.k, 1));
384	  layout_SFB = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFB(cute::make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.k, 1));
385	  block_B.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_B)));
386	  block_C.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_C)));
387	  block_D.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_D)));
388	  block_reference_D.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(layout_D)));
389	  block_SFA.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(filter_zeros(layout_SFA))));
390	  block_SFB.reset(cutlass::make_Coord(size(filter_zeros(layout_SFB))));
391	  initialize_block(block_B.host_view(), seed + 2022);
392	  initialize_block(block_C.host_view(), seed + 2023);
393	  initialize_block(block_SFA.host_view(), seed + 2024);
394	  initialize_block(block_SFB.host_view(), seed + 2025);
395	  block_B.sync_device();
396	  block_C.sync_device();
397	  block_SFA.sync_device();
398	  block_SFB.sync_device();
399	  return true;
400	}
401	// Populates a Gemm::Arguments structure from the given commandline options
402	typename Gemm::Arguments args_from_options(const Options &options)
403	{
404	  typename Gemm::Arguments arguments {
405	    cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode::kGemm,
406	    {options.m, options.n, options.k, 1},
407	    { // Mainloop arguments
408	      block_A.device_data(), layout_A,
409	      block_B.device_data(), stride_B,
410	      block_E.device_data(), layout_E,
411	      block_SFA.device_data(), layout_SFA,
412	      block_SFB.device_data(), layout_SFB
413	    },
414	    { // Epilogue arguments
415	      {options.alpha, options.beta},
416	      block_C.device_data(), stride_C,
417	      block_D.device_data(), stride_D
418	    }
419	  };
420	  return arguments;
421	}
422	bool verify(const Options &options) {
423	  using namespace cute;
424	  // Create the arguments for host reference implementation
425	  Tensor tensor_A = make_tensor(make_iterator(block_A_Decompressed.host_data()), layout_A);
426	  Tensor tensor_SFA = make_tensor(block_SFA.host_data(), layout_SFA);
427	  Tensor tensor_B = make_tensor(make_iterator(block_B.host_data()), layout_B);
428	  Tensor tensor_SFB = make_tensor(block_SFB.host_data(), layout_SFB);
429	  Tensor tensor_E = make_tensor(make_iterator(block_E.host_data()), layout_E);
430	
431	  cutlass::reference::host::GettBlockScalingMainloopParams<
432	      ElementAccumulator,                 // ElementAccumulator
433	      decltype(tensor_A),                 // TensorA
434	      decltype(tensor_SFA),               // TensorSfA
435	      decltype(tensor_B),                 // TensorB
436	      decltype(tensor_SFB)                // TensorSfB
437	    > mainloop_params{tensor_A, tensor_SFA, tensor_B, tensor_SFB};
438	  auto tensor_C = cute::make_tensor(make_iterator(block_C.host_data()), layout_C);
439	  auto tensor_D = cute::make_tensor(make_iterator(block_reference_D.host_data()), layout_D);
440	
441	  cutlass::reference::host::GettBlockScalingEpilogueParams<
442	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementScalar
443	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementAccumulator
444	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementCompute
445	      decltype(tensor_C),                   // TensorC
446	      decltype(tensor_D)                    // TensorD
447	    > epilogue_params{options.alpha, options.beta, tensor_C, tensor_D};
448	  cutlass::reference::host::Gemm3x(mainloop_params, epilogue_params);
449	  // Comparison
450	  block_D.sync_host();
451	
452	  bool passed = cutlass::reference::host::TensorEquals(block_reference_D.host_view(), block_reference_D.host_view());
453	  passed &= (cutlass::reference::host::TensorNorm(block_reference_D.host_view()) > 0);
454	  passed &= (cutlass::reference::host::TensorNorm(block_D.host_view()) > 0);
455	  return passed;
456	}
457	/// Execute a given example GEMM computation
458	template <typename Gemm>
459	int run(Options &options)
460	{
461	  // Initialization
462	  if(!initialize(options))
463	  {
464	    std::cerr << " Initialization failed! " << std::endl;
465	    exit(-1);
466	  }
467	
468	  // Instantiate CUTLASS kernel depending on templates
469	  Gemm gemm;
470	  // Create a structure of gemm kernel arguments suitable for invoking an instance of Gemm
471	  auto arguments = args_from_options(options);
472	  // Using the arguments, query for extra workspace required for matrix multiplication computation
473	  size_t workspace_size = Gemm::get_workspace_size(arguments);
474	  // Allocate workspace memory
475	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
476	  // Check if the problem size is supported or not
477	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.can_implement(arguments));
478	  // Initialize CUTLASS kernel with arguments and workspace pointer
479	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
480	  // Correctness / Warmup iteration
481	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
482	  cudaDeviceSynchronize();
483	  // Check if output from CUTLASS kernel and reference kernel are equal or not
484	  Result result;
485	  result.passed = verify(options);
486	  std::cout << "  Disposition: " << (result.passed ? "Passed" : "Failed") << std::endl;
487	  if (!result.passed) {
488	    exit(-1);
489	  }
490	  // Run profiling loop
491	  if (options.iterations > 0)
492	  {
493	    GpuTimer timer;
494	    timer.start();
495	    for (int iter = 0; iter < options.iterations; ++iter) {
496	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
497	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
498	    }
499	    timer.stop();
500	    // Compute average runtime and GFLOPs.
501	    float elapsed_ms = timer.elapsed_millis();
502	    result.avg_runtime_ms = double(elapsed_ms) / double(options.iterations);
503	    result.gflops = options.gflops(result.avg_runtime_ms / 1000.0);
504	    std::cout << "  Problem Size: " << options.m << 'x' << options.n << 'x' << options.k << std::endl;
505	    std::cout << "  Avg runtime: " << result.avg_runtime_ms << " ms" << std::endl;
506	    std::cout << "  GFLOPS: " << result.gflops << std::endl;
507	  }
508	  return 0;
509	}
510	#endif // defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM120_SUPPORTED) || defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM121_SUPPORTED)

512	int main(int argc, char const **args) {
513	
514	  // CUTLASS must be compiled with CUDA 12.8 or higher Toolkit for SM120 support,
515	  // or CUDA 12.9 or higher for SM121 support.
516	  // Must have compute capability at least 120.
517	#if defined(CUTLASS_ARCH_MMA_SM120_SUPPORTED)
518	  if (__CUDACC_VER_MAJOR__ < 12 || (__CUDACC_VER_MAJOR__ == 12 && __CUDACC_VER_MINOR__ < 8)) {
519	    std::cerr << "This example requires CUDA 12.8 or newer for SM120 support." << std::endl;
520	    // Returning zero so this test passes on older Toolkits. Its actions are no-op.
521	    return 0;
522	  }

32	/*! \file
33	    \brief A Narrow Precision Sparse GEMM example using CUTLASS for the NVIDIA Blackwell SM100 architecture.
34	
35	    This example demonstrates a simple way to instantiate and run a blockscaled NVFP4 Sparse GEMM on the NVIDIA Blackwell SM100 architecture.
36	
37	    The Blackwell SM100 CUTLASS kernel uses the new Block Scaled Tensor Core MMA Instructions (tcgen05.mma.blockscaled) introduced
38	    on the Blackwell architecture (sm100a) which have 2x throughput compared to fp8 Tensor Core MMA instructions (tcgen05.mma)
39	    and 4x throughput compared to fp8 Hopper Tensor Core MMA Instructions (WGMMA) (See https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution).
40	
41	    Similar to 83_blackwell_sparse_gemm, this kernel leverages:
42	    1. Per-SM memory called Tensor Memory (TMEM)  (Please refer to CUDA 12.8 docs on https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/).
43	
44	    2. The extended warp-specialized kernel design introduced in Hopper enabled by use of TMEM
45	    which allows us to decouple the execution of MMA and epilogue into separate warps.
46	
47	    3. A new SW controlled dynamic scheduler based on cluster launch control (See https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/parallel-thread-execution).
48	
49	    Usage:
50	      $ ./examples/84_blackwell_narrow_precision_sparse_gemm/84a_blackwell_nvfp4_bf16_sparse_gemm --m=2048 --n=2048 --k=2048
51	*/

309	  /// Compute performance in GFLOP/s
310	  double gflops(double runtime_s) const
311	  {
312	    // Two flops per multiply-add
313	    uint64_t flop = uint64_t(2) * m * n * k;
314	    double gflop = double(flop) / double(1.0e9);
315	    return gflop / runtime_s;

345	/// Helper to initialize a block of device data
346	template <typename Element, typename Layout>
347	void initialize_tensor(
348	  cutlass::TensorView<Element, Layout> view,
349	  uint64_t seed) {
350	
351	  double scope_max, scope_min;
352	  int bits_input = cutlass::sizeof_bits<Element>::value;
353	
354	  if (bits_input == 1) {
355	    scope_max = 2;
356	    scope_min = 0;
357	  }
358	    else if (bits_input <= 6) {
359	    scope_max = 2;
360	    scope_min = -2;
361	  }
362	  else if (bits_input <= 8) {
363	    if constexpr (cute::is_same_v<Element, cutlass::float_ue8m0_t>){
364	      scope_max = 4;
365	      scope_min = 1;
366	    }
367	    else {
368	      scope_max = 1;
369	      scope_min = -1;
370	    }
371	  }
372	  else{
373	    scope_max = 4;
374	    scope_min = -4;
375	  }
376	  cutlass::reference::host::TensorFillRandomUniform(
377	    view, seed, scope_max, scope_min, 0);
378	}
379	
380	/// Initialize operands to be used in the GEMM and reference GEMM
381	bool initialize(const Options &options) {
382	
383	  problem_shape = make_tuple(options.m, options.n, options.k, options.l);
384	
385	  // * Get A B C D size
386	  stride_A = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, {options.m, options.k, 1});
387	  stride_B = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideB{}, {options.n, options.k, 1});
388	  stride_C = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideC{}, {options.m, options.n, 1});
389	  stride_D = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideD{}, {options.m, options.n, 1});
390	  layout_A = SparseConfig::fill_layoutA(problem_shape);
391	  layout_E = SparseConfig::fill_layoutE(problem_shape);
392	  layout_SFA = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(problem_shape);
393	  layout_SFB = Sm1xxBlkScaledConfig::tile_atom_to_shape_SFB(problem_shape);
394	
395	  // * Get ACompress & E size
396	  CompressorUtility compressor_utility(problem_shape, stride_A);
397	
398	  // TensorE
399	  // In unit of ElementE (uint8_t), after alignment requirement
400	  // M-dim: TensorEAtom_M alignment
401	  // K-dim: TensorEAtom_K alignment
402	  int KAlignedE = compressor_utility.get_metadata_k_physical();
403	  int MAlignedE = compressor_utility.get_metadata_m_physical();
404	
405	  // TensorA Compressed
406	  // In unit of ElementARaw, after alignment requirement
407	  // M-dim: TMA alignment
408	  // K-dim: TMA alignment
409	  int KAlignedAC = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_k_physical();
410	  int MAlignedAC = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_m_physical();
411	
412	  stride_A_compressed = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, cute::make_shape(options.m, KAlignedAC, options.l));
413	  stride_E            = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideE{}, cute::make_shape(MAlignedE, KAlignedE, options.l));
414	
415	  // * Get SFA & SFB size
416	  auto k_blks = cutlass::ceil_div(options.k, cute::size<1>(shape(SfAtom{})));
417	  auto m_blks = cutlass::ceil_div(options.m, Blk_MN{});
418	  auto n_blks = cutlass::ceil_div(options.n, Blk_MN{});
419	
420	  // * Allocate Tensor
421	  auto a_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(options.m * options.l, options.k);
422	  auto b_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(options.k, options.n * options.l);
423	  auto e_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(MAlignedE * options.l, KAlignedE);
424	  auto a_comp_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(MAlignedAC * options.l, KAlignedAC);
425	  auto c_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(options.m * options.l, options.n);
426	  auto d_coord = cutlass::make_Coord(options.m * options.l, options.n);
427	  auto sfa_coord   = cutlass::make_Coord(m_blks * Blk_MN{} * options.l, k_blks * Blk_SF{});
428	  auto sfb_coord   = cutlass::make_Coord(n_blks * Blk_MN{} * options.l, k_blks * Blk_SF{});
429	
430	  tensor_A.resize(a_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagA>::layout_factory(a_coord, stride_factor_A));
431	  tensor_A_compressed.resize(a_comp_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagA>::layout_factory(a_comp_coord, stride_factor_A));
432	  tensor_B.resize(b_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagB>::layout_factory(b_coord, stride_factor_B));
433	  tensor_E.resize(e_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagE>::layout_factory(e_coord, stride_factor_E));
434	  tensor_C.resize(c_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagC>::layout_factory(c_coord, stride_factor_C));
435	  tensor_D.resize(c_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagD>::layout_factory(d_coord, stride_factor_D));
436	  reference_D.resize(c_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagD>::layout_factory(d_coord, stride_factor_D), false);
437	  tensor_SFA.resize(sfa_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagA>::layout_factory(sfa_coord, stride_factor_A));
438	  tensor_SFB.resize(sfb_coord, cutlass::layout::Affine2Layout_Factory<LayoutTagB>::layout_factory(sfb_coord, stride_factor_B));
439	
440	  // * Random init
441	  initialize_tensor(tensor_A.host_view(), seed + 2021);
442	  initialize_tensor(tensor_B.host_view(), seed + 2022);
443	  initialize_tensor(tensor_C.host_view(), seed + 2023);
444	  initialize_tensor(tensor_SFA.host_view(), seed + 2024);
445	  initialize_tensor(tensor_SFB.host_view(), seed + 2025);
446	  cutlass::reference::host::TensorCopy(reference_D.host_view(), tensor_C.host_view());
447	
448	  // * Random fill 50% A with zero
449	  compressor_utility.structure_sparse_zero_mask_fill(tensor_A.host_data(), static_cast<int>(seed + 2023));
450	
451	  tensor_A.sync_device();
452	  tensor_B.sync_device();
453	  tensor_C.sync_device();
454	  tensor_SFA.sync_device();
455	  tensor_SFB.sync_device();
456	
457	  // * Compress
458	  cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo hw_info;
459	  hw_info.device_id = 0;
460	  hw_info.sm_count = cutlass::KernelHardwareInfo::query_device_multiprocessor_count(hw_info.device_id);
461	  typename Compressor::Arguments arguments{
462	    problem_shape,
463	    {tensor_A.device_data(),
464	      stride_A,
465	      tensor_A_compressed.device_data(),
466	      tensor_E.device_data()},
467	    {hw_info}
468	  };
469	
470	  Compressor compressor_op;
471	  size_t workspace_size = Compressor::get_workspace_size(arguments);
472	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
473	
474	  cutlass::Status status {cutlass::Status::kSuccess };
475	  status = compressor_op.can_implement(arguments);
476	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
477	    return false;
478	  }
479	
480	  status = compressor_op.initialize(arguments, workspace.get());
481	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
482	    return false;
483	  }
484	
485	  status = compressor_op.run();
486	  if (status != cutlass::Status::kSuccess) {
487	    return false;
488	  }
489	
490	  auto result = cudaDeviceSynchronize();
491	  if (result != cudaSuccess) {
492	    return false;
493	  }
494	
495	  tensor_E.sync_host();
496	  tensor_A_compressed.sync_host();
497	
498	  return true;
499	}

501	// Populates a Gemm::Arguments structure from the given commandline options
502	typename Gemm::Arguments args_from_options(const Options &options)
503	{
504	  using ArrayElementA = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::ArrayElementA;
505	  using ArrayElementB = typename Gemm::GemmKernel::CollectiveMainloop::ArrayElementB;
506	
507	  typename Gemm::Arguments arguments {
508	    cutlass::gemm::GemmUniversalMode::kGemm,
509	    {options.m, options.n, options.k, 1},
510	    {
511	      reinterpret_cast<ArrayElementA *>(tensor_A_compressed.device_data()), layout_A,
512	      reinterpret_cast<ArrayElementB *>(tensor_B.device_data()), stride_B,
513	      tensor_E.device_data(), layout_E,
514	      tensor_SFA.device_data(), layout_SFA,
515	      tensor_SFB.device_data(), layout_SFB
516	    },
517	    {
518	      {options.alpha, options.beta},
519	      tensor_C.device_data(), stride_C,
520	      tensor_D.device_data(), stride_D
521	    }
522	  };
523	
524	  return arguments;
525	}

527	bool verify(const Options &options) {
528	  using namespace cute;
529	
530	  // Create the arguments for host reference implementation
531	  auto A = make_tensor(make_iterator(tensor_A.host_data()), layout_A);
532	  auto SFA = make_tensor(tensor_SFA.host_data(), layout_SFA);
533	  auto B = make_tensor(make_iterator(tensor_B.host_data()),
534	    make_layout(make_shape(options.n, options.k, options.l), stride_B));
535	  auto SFB = make_tensor(tensor_SFB.host_data(), layout_SFB);
536	
537	  cutlass::reference::host::GettMainloopParams<
538	      ElementAccumulator,
539	      decltype(A),
540	      decltype(B),
541	      decltype(SFA),
542	      decltype(SFB)> mainloop_params{A, SFA, B, SFB};
543	
544	  auto C = make_tensor(make_iterator(tensor_C.host_data()),
545	    make_layout(make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.l), stride_C));
546	  auto D = make_tensor(make_iterator(reference_D.host_data()),
547	    make_layout(make_shape(options.m, options.n, options.l), stride_D));
548	
549	  cutlass::reference::host::GettBlockScalingEpilogueParams<
550	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementScalar
551	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementAccumulator
552	      ElementAccumulator,                   // ElementCompute
553	      decltype(C),                          // TensorC
554	      decltype(D)                           // TensorD
555	    > epilogue_params{
556	      options.alpha,
557	      options.beta,
558	      C,
559	      D};
560	
561	  cutlass::reference::host::Gemm3x(mainloop_params, epilogue_params);
562	
563	  // Comparison
564	  tensor_D.sync_host();
565	  bool passed = cutlass::reference::host::TensorEquals(reference_D.host_view(), tensor_D.host_view());
566	  passed &= (cutlass::reference::host::TensorNorm(reference_D.host_view()) > 0);
567	  passed &= (cutlass::reference::host::TensorNorm(tensor_D.host_view()) > 0);
568	
569	  return passed;

572	/// Execute a given example GEMM computation
573	template <typename Gemm>
574	int run(Options &options)
575	{
576	  auto init_pass = initialize(options);
577	  if (not init_pass) {
578	    std::cout << "Initialization failure" << std::endl;
579	    exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
580	  }
581	
582	  // Instantiate CUTLASS kernel depending on templates
583	  Gemm gemm;
584	
585	  // Create a structure of gemm kernel arguments suitable for invoking an instance of Gemm
586	  auto arguments = args_from_options(options);
587	
588	  // Using the arguments, query for extra workspace required for matrix multiplication computation
589	  size_t workspace_size = Gemm::get_workspace_size(arguments);
590	
591	  // Allocate workspace memory
592	  cutlass::device_memory::allocation<uint8_t> workspace(workspace_size);
593	
594	  // Check if the problem size is supported or not
595	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.can_implement(arguments));
596	
597	  // Initialize CUTLASS kernel with arguments and workspace pointer
598	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
599	
600	  // Correctness / Warmup iteration
601	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
602	
603	  cudaDeviceSynchronize();
604	
605	  // Check if output from CUTLASS kernel and reference kernel are equal or not
606	  Result result;
607	  result.passed = verify(options);
608	
609	  std::cout << "  Disposition: " << (result.passed ? "Passed" : "Failed") << std::endl;
610	
611	  if (not result.passed) {
612	    exit(-1);
613	  }
614	
615	  // Run profiling loop
616	  if (options.iterations > 0)
617	  {
618	    GpuTimer timer;
619	    timer.start();
620	    for (int iter = 0; iter < options.iterations; ++iter) {
621	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.get()));
622	      CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run());
623	    }
624	    timer.stop();
625	
626	    // Compute average runtime and GFLOPs.
627	    float elapsed_ms = timer.elapsed_millis();
628	    result.avg_runtime_ms = double(elapsed_ms) / double(options.iterations);
629	    result.gflops = options.gflops(result.avg_runtime_ms / 1000.0);
630	
631	
632	    std::cout << "  Problem Size: " << options.m << 'x' << options.n << 'x' << options.k << std::endl;
633	    std::cout << "  Avg runtime: " << result.avg_runtime_ms << " ms" << std::endl;
634	    std::cout << "  GFLOPS: " << result.gflops << std::endl;
635	  }
636	
637	  return 0;
638	}

337	void runGemm(
338	    at::Tensor& D,
339	    at::Tensor const& A,
340	    at::Tensor const& B,
341	    at::Tensor const& A_sf,
342	    at::Tensor const& B_sf,
343	    at::Tensor const& alpha,
344	    int64_t m,
345	    int64_t n,
346	    int64_t k,
347	    cudaStream_t stream) {

350

352	  auto const workspace_options = torch::TensorOptions().dtype(torch::kUInt8).device(A.device());
353	  auto workspace = torch::empty(workspace_size, workspace_options);
354	
355	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.can_implement(arguments));
356	
357	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.initialize(arguments, workspace.data_ptr(), stream));
358	
359	  CUTLASS_CHECK(gemm.run(arguments, workspace.data_ptr(), stream));
360	}

191	  void structure_sparse_zero_mask_fill(void* host_a_ptr, uint64_t seed) {
192	    
193	    constexpr int ChunkSize = LogicalElemsAMmaRawPerChunk;
194	    using ChunkElement = cute::uint_bit_t<cute::sizeof_bits_v<ElementAMmaRaw>>;
195	
196	    cute::Tensor gA_eltA = cute::make_tensor(
197	        cute::recast_ptr<ElementA>(host_a_ptr),
198	        cute::make_layout(make_shape(M, K, L), dA));
199	
200	    // Input TensorA is handled in unit of ElementAMmaRaw instead of ElementA
201	    cute::Tensor gA = cute::recast<ChunkElement>(gA_eltA);
202	
203	    // Extract out the Chunk from K-mode
204	    Tensor gA_chunk = cute::zipped_divide(gA, cute::Shape<_1,cute::Int<ChunkSize>>{}); // (Chunk, Rest)
205	
206	    // Half of the data is zero to indicate sparsityA = 2
207	    std::array<int, ChunkSize> nnzb_indicator{};
208	    for (size_t i = 1; i < nnzb_indicator.size(); i += 2) {
209	      nnzb_indicator.at(i) = 1;
210	    }
211	
212	    std::mt19937 rng(seed);
213	    auto rest_shape = cute::shape<1>(gA_chunk);
214	    for (auto iter = cute::make_coord_iterator(rest_shape); iter != cute::ForwardCoordIteratorSentinel{}; ++iter) {
215	      std::shuffle(nnzb_indicator.begin(), nnzb_indicator.end(), rng);
216	      for (int c = 0; c < size<0>(gA_chunk); ++c) {                        // for each elem within chunk
217	        if (nnzb_indicator[c] == 0) {
218	          gA_chunk(c, *iter) = ChunkElement{0};
219	        }
220	      }  // end of within chunk
221	    }    // end of chunk_idx
222	  }
223	
224	  int M{-1};
225	  int K{-1};
226	  int L{-1};
227	  StrideA dA{};
228

231	  int M_alignedA{-1};
232	  int K_alignedE{-1};
233	  int M_alignedE{-1};
234	};

28	def _filter_compiled_extensions(file_list):
29	    """Filter and prioritize compiled extensions over Python source files."""
30	    compiled_extensions = [".so", ".pyd", ".dll"]  # Common compiled extension suffixes
31	    compiled_files = []
32	    other_files = []
33	
34	    for file_path in file_list:
35	        path = Path(file_path)
36	        # Check if it's a compiled extension (including complex names like .abi3.so, .cpython-312.so)
37	        if any(
38	            str(path).endswith(ext) or ext in str(path) for ext in compiled_extensions
39	        ):
40	            compiled_files.append(file_path)
41	        else:
42	            other_files.append(file_path)
43	
44	    # Return compiled files first, then others
45	    return compiled_files + other_files

201	  // This function is used to revert a CuTe layout to a Cutlass layout tag (RowMajor/ColumnMajor)
202	  template <
203	    typename ShapeA,
204	    typename StrideA
205	  >
206	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE
207	  static constexpr auto
208	  deduce_layoutA_tag(Layout<ShapeA, StrideA> layout_a) {
209	    /*
210	      (m, (2, k/2), l) : (2, (1, m*2), m*k) M-major
211	      (m, (2, k/2), l) : (k, (1, 2), m*k) K-major
212	    */
213	    // Check if the given layout_a is possibly a sparse tensorA layout.
214	    static_assert(rank_v<ShapeA> == 3 && depth_v<ShapeA> == 2, "Rank and depth mismatch with the sparse tensorA's layout.");
215	    static_assert(rank(get<1>(ShapeA{})) == 2 && rank(flatten(ShapeA{})) == 4,
216	                  "Not likely to be a sparse tensorA's layout.");
217	    static_assert(get<1,0>(StrideA{}) == 1 && get<1,0>(ShapeA{}) == ElementASparsity{},
218	                  "Not likely to be a sparse tensorA's layout.");
219	    static_assert(get<0>(StrideA{}) == ElementASparsity{} || get<1,1>(StrideA{}) == ElementASparsity{},
220	                  "Not likely to be a sparse tensorA's layout.");
221	
222	    if constexpr (get<0>(StrideA{}) == ElementASparsity{}) {
223	      return cutlass::layout::ColumnMajor{};
224	    }
225	    else {
226	      return  cutlass::layout::RowMajor{};
227	    }
228	  }
229	
230	  // The following two functions are provided for user fill dynamic problem size to the layout_a/e.
231	  template <
232	    class ProblemShape
233	  >
234	  CUTE_HOST_DEVICE
235	  static constexpr auto
236	  fill_layoutA(ProblemShape problem_shape) {
237	    // * Purpose of this function
238	    // This function is sparse gemm equivalent of 
239	    //
240	    //   ```cpp
241	    //   using LayoutATag = cutlass::layout::RowMajor;
242	    //   using StrideA = cutlass::gemm::TagToStrideA_t<GmemLayoutBTag>; // ( cute::Stride<int64_t, cute::Int<1>, int64_t> )
243	    //   auto stride_a = cutlass::make_cute_packed_stride(StrideA{}, cute::make_shape(M, K, L)); // (M, cute::Int<1>, L)
244	    //   auto layout_a = cute::make_layout(cute::make_shape(M, K, L), stride_a);
245	    //   ```
246	    //
247	    // Unlike dense gemm where we can simply call `TagToStrideA_t` resp. `make_cute_packed_stride`
248	    // to get the shape and stride, sparse gemm needs to consider the cute::sparse_elem<> representation.
249	    // Thus, it's easier to construct the layout directly.
250	    //
251	    // * NOTE
252	    // 1. Returned layout should be used with `cute::sparse_elem<>` pointer, instead of raw element A ptr
253	    // 2. `TensorAAlignmentK` already include 2x sparsity factor along K dim.
254	    //    e.g. MMA FP4 A is K major, TensorAAlignmentK = 256. When used with `cute::sparse_elem<2, f4>`, TensorAComp will
255	    //         have 128 element alignment along k-dim
256	    const auto [M, N, K, L] = problem_shape;
257	
258	    // Round up to satisfy TensorA Alignment requirement
259	    const auto M_AlignedAC = cutlass::round_up(M, TensorAAlignmentM{});
260	    const auto K_AlignedAC = cutlass::round_up(K, TensorAAlignmentK{});
261	
262	    if constexpr (IsKMajor) {
263	      return make_layout(
264	        make_shape(int32_t(M_AlignedAC),
265	                   make_shape(ElementASparsity{}, int32_t(K_AlignedAC / ElementASparsity{})),
266	                   int32_t(L)),
267	        make_stride(int64_t(K_AlignedAC),
268	                    make_stride(_1{}, ElementASparsity{}),
269	                    (L == 1) ? int64_t(0) : int64_t(M_AlignedAC * K_AlignedAC))
270	      );
271	    }
272	    else {
273	      return make_layout(
274	        make_shape(int32_t(M_AlignedAC),
275	                   make_shape(ElementASparsity{}, int32_t(K_AlignedAC) / ElementASparsity{}),
276	                   int32_t(L)),
277	        make_stride(ElementASparsity{},
278	                    make_stride(_1{}, int64_t(M_AlignedAC) * ElementASparsity{}),
279	                    (L == 1) ? int64_t(0) : int64_t(M_AlignedAC * K_AlignedAC))
280	      );
281	    }
282	  }

64	    x_sf: torch.Tensor,
65	    weight_sf: torch.Tensor,

72	
73	    Computes  silu(α · A @ W_gate.T) * (α · A @ W_up.T)  and quantizes to NVFP4
74	    matching the `silu_and_mul_scaled_fp4_grouped_quant` output format.
75	
76	    Args:
77	      x_fp4: (M, K/2) uint8 NVFP4-packed activation
78	      gate_up_weight: (N, K/2) uint8 NVFP4-packed weight, where N = 2 ·
79	        intermediate. Rows [0, intermediate) are W_gate; rows [intermediate, N)
80	        are W_up.
81	      x_sf: block scales for A, fp8e4m3
82	      weight_sf: block scales for B
83	      alpha: scalar FP32 alpha

85	      input_scale_inv: scalar FP32, used both as A's alpha and for FP4 output

**Python Wrapper (python/sgl_kernel/gemm.py, line 163-177):**
```python
def cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm(
    a: torch.Tensor,
    b: torch.Tensor,
    block_scale_a: torch.Tensor,
    block_scale_b: torch.Tensor,
    alpha: torch.Tensor,
    out_dtype: torch.dtype,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    assert a.ndim == 2 and b.ndim == 2
    m, n = a.shape[0], b.shape[0]
    out = torch.empty((m, n), dtype=out_dtype, device=a.device)
    torch.ops.sgl_kernel.cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm.default(
        out, a, b, block_scale_a, block_scale_b, alpha
    )
    return out
```

## INVESTIGATION FINDINGS

### **TOPIC A: "Fast Validate" Mode in GEMM SOP**

Found and documented in `/user_4813494d/openbmb/docs/gemm/sop.md` and `/user_4813494d/openbmb/docs/gemm/methodology.md`.

**Path:** `/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/quick_validate.sh` (185 lines)

**Design & Purpose (§3.5 in methodology.md):**
This is the **unique final performance gating standard** for all kernel patches in the SOAR project. NOT a full micro-benchmark, NOT mini_bench—it's a lightweight 25-second end-to-end validation script.

**Execution Flow:**
1. **Prefill phase:** 5 chunk-sized prompts (~8K tokens each, max_tokens=1 to measure pure prefill time)
   - Prompts: "The quick brown fox..." × 1500 chars, Lorem ipsum × 1100, etc.
   - Output: prefill_tok/s (median, min, p90, mean, stdev)

2. **Decode single-stream (5 iterations):** Short 32-token prompt, max_tokens=128, ignore_eos=True
   - Output: decode_tok/s per request

3. **Batch decode concurrency:** bs ∈ {4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32}
   - Full batch warmup via bs=32 first (avoids cold-path -25% penalty)
   - Each bs runs 2 trials, takes min wall time
   - Output: per_req_tok/s (aggregate throughput / batch_size)

**API Call Pattern:**
```python
POST /v1/completions
{
  "model": "minicpm",
  "prompt": <text>,
  "max_tokens": <int>,
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "ignore_eos": <bool>  # True for decode, False/absent for prefill
}
```

**Key Parameters:**
- PREFILL_N = 5 prompts
- DECODE_N = 5 requests
- DECODE_TOKENS = 128
- Batch sizes: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32
- API_BASE = http://127.0.0.1:30000 (default)

**Output Format:**
JSON saved to `/user_4813494d/openbmb/outputs/quick_validate/<TS>_<label>.json`
```
{
  "prefill": {
    "median_s", "min_s", "p90_s", "mean_s", "stdev_s",
    "mean_prompt_tokens", "mean_prefill_tok_s"
  },
  "decode_single": {same stats},
  "decode_batch": {
    "bs4": {"wall_s", "total_tokens", "aggregate_tok/s", "per_req_tok/s"},
    "bs8": {...}, ...
  }
}
```

**Gating Criteria (§3.5 in methodology.md):**
- **Pass threshold:** ≥ 1% improvement OR middle ± 0.5% (neutral)
- **SNR requirement:** (patch - baseline) ≥ 3× baseline_stdev
- **Protocol:** A/B/A interleave (≥3 baseline + ≥2 patch, kill/restart server between each)
- **Insufficient for:** dispatch path changes, bucket boundary shifts, CUTLASS_OVERRIDE/MARLIN_UPPER changes → requires mini_bench S1/S8/Smax three-tier gate first

**Why NOT mini_bench?** (§3.5 in sop.md)
- Long bench (5-15 min) amplifies cold startup, DVFS stickiness, autotune cache miss
- ±3% SNR matches 1-3% patch ROI → A/B/A needs 1-3 hours
- quick_validate: 25 sec per run, targets 1-3% SNR window precisely

### **TOPIC B: CUTLASS sm_120 Sparse 2:4 Metadata Extraction for NVFP4**

Three example files provide the complete inference pipeline. Here's the comparison:

**Files Located:**
- `80a_blackwell_geforce_mxfp8_bf16_sparse_gemm.cu` (sparse MXFP8 input → BF16 output, NO scale factor output)
- `80b_blackwell_geforce_nvfp4_nvfp4_sparse_gemm.cu` (sparse NVFP4 input → NVFP4 output WITH scale factor output SFD)
- `84a_blackwell_nvfp4_bf16_sparse_gemm.cu` (sparse NVFP4 input → BF16 output, sm_100/Blackwell)

**RECOMMENDATION FOR MiniCPM-SALA SPARSE NVFP4 INFERENCE:** **80a** (MXFP8 input/BF16 output variant)
- Rationale: (1) Output type = BF16 matches inference KV cache / attention matmul dtype; (2) No SFD (scale factor) output saves epilogue cost; (3) KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecializedMxf8f6f4Acc2x4Sm120 schedule is sm_120 GeForce RTX 50 optimized; (4) Simpler epilogue than 80b

---

### **Metadata E Layout & Compression Pipeline**

**CompressorUtility Interface (lines 308-322 in 80b, replicated identically in 80a):**

```cpp
using CompressorUtility = cutlass::transform::kernel::StructuredSparseCompressorUtility<
  cute::Shape<int, int, int, int>,           // ProblemShape: (M, N, K, 1)
  ElementA::DataType,                        // float_e2m1_t for NVFP4
  LayoutATag,                                // RowMajor
  SparseConfig>;

CompressorUtility compressor_utility(workload, stride_A);  // HOST-side utility
int aligned_m_e = compressor_utility.get_metadata_m_physical();  // Output M alignment
int aligned_k_e = compressor_utility.get_metadata_k_physical();  // Output K/meta_sparsity
int aligned_m_a = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_m_physical();   // Compressed A: M
int aligned_k_a = compressor_utility.get_tensorA_k_physical();   // Compressed A: K/2
```

**Host-side Setup Cost (one-time per session):**
1. Allocate dense uncompressed A: `[M, K]` floats
2. Call `compressor_utility.structure_sparse_zero_mask_fill(A_ptr, seed)` to inject 50% zeros in 2:4 pattern
3. Allocate compressed A: `[M_aligned, K_aligned/2]` (or elements in compact form)
4. Allocate metadata E: `[M_aligned, K_aligned / ElementEMmaSparsity]`

**Device-side Compression (transactional, one-time launch):**
```cpp
using Compressor = cutlass::transform::device::TransformUniversalAdapter<CompressorKernel>;
typename Compressor::Arguments compressor_args{
  {M, N, K, 1},
  {block_A_decompressed.device_ptr(), stride_A,
   block_A_compressed.device_ptr(),
   block_E.device_ptr()},
  {hw_info}  // SM count for grid scheduling
};

Compressor compressor_op;
size_t ws = Compressor::get_workspace_size(compressor_args);
compressor_op.initialize(compressor_args, workspace);
compressor_op.run();  // Computes: A_compressed, E (metadata)
```

---

### **Metadata E (Sparse Indices) Physical Layout**

From `/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/sparse_fp4_probe/cutlass-main/include/cutlass/gemm/collective/builders/sm1xx_sparse_config.inl` (lines 116–131):

**For NVFP4 2:4 sparsity (IsF8F6F4 case):**
```cpp
using ElementEMmaSparsity = Int<8>;  // 8 indices packed per uint8_t byte
using TensorEAtom_MMA_S8orF8F6F4 = Layout<Shape<_128, _128>,  // Atoms
                                          Stride<_128, _1>>;
```

**Shape after compression:**
- Dense: E[M, K] uint8_t (two 4-bit indices per byte)
- After alignment (lines 292-307 in sm1xx_sparse_config.inl):
  - M_AlignedE = round_up(M, 128)
  - K_AlignedE = round_up(K, 128)
  - **Physical output:** E[M_AlignedE, K_AlignedE / 8] uint8_t
    - Each K dimension reduced by 8× (8 indices = 4 bits × 2 indices per byte, packed)

**Layout formula (CuTe layout):**
```cpp
return make_layout(
  make_shape(make_shape(128, M_AlignedE / 128),
             make_shape(128, K_AlignedE / 128),
             1),  // Batch
  make_stride(make_stride(128, cosize(TensorEAtom)),
              make_stride(1, M_AlignedE * 128),
              M_AlignedE * K_AlignedE)
);
```
→ Row-major traversal: M-inner (stride 128), K-outer (stride M_aligned×128)

---

### **Compressed Weight A Layout**

From sm1xx_sparse_config.inl fill_layoutA() (lines 260–282):

**Shape after compression (K-major / RowMajor A):**
```cpp
K_AlignedA = round_up(K, 256);  // TensorAAlignmentK = 128*2 for NVFP4
M_AlignedA = round_up(M, 1);    // TensorAAlignmentM = 1
return make_layout(
  make_shape(M_AlignedA, make_shape(2, K_AlignedA/2), L),
  make_stride(K_AlignedA, make_stride(1, 2), M*K)
);
```
→ **Physical: A_compressed[M_aligned, K_aligned/2]** float_e2m1_t
  - Stride: each row = K_aligned elements, but packed to K_aligned/2 physical slots (2 values per native element)
  - Interpretation: sparse_elem<2, float_e2m1_t> pairs

---

### **NVFP4 Scale Factor (SF) Layout in Sparse Path**

From `/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/sparse_fp4_probe/cutlass-main/include/cutlass/detail/sm100_blockscaled_layout.hpp` (lines 49–69, replicated for sm_120):

**Scale Factor block structure:**
- Blk_MN = 128 (rows/cols per block)
- Blk_SF = 4 (scale factors per block)
- SfAtom: Layout<Shape<Shape<32, 4>, Shape<SFVecSize, 4>>, ...>

**SFA (scale for A) tile shape (line 93):**
```cpp
tile_atom_to_shape_SFA(make_shape(M, K, L)) →
tile_to_shape(SfAtom, make_shape(M, K, L), Step<_2, _1, _3>)
```
→ Produces **ceil(M/128) × ceil(K/SFVecSize) × L** scale factor elements
  - SFVecSize depends on kernel variant (typically 32 for NVFP4)

**Compression does NOT modify SFA layout** — scale factors are pre-computed separately per block and stay full-precision (float_ue4m3_t for NVFP4 output)

---

### **Three Examples Comparison**

| Aspect | 80a (MXFP8→BF16) | 80b (NVFP4→NVFP4) | 84a (NVFP4→BF16, sm_100) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Input dtype** | nv_float4_t<float_e4m3_t> | nv_float4_t<float_e2m1_t> | nv_float4_t<float_e2m1_t> |
| **Output dtype** | bfloat16_t | float_e2m1_t | bfloat16_t |
| **SFD (output SF)?** | ❌ No | ✅ Yes (float_ue4m3_t) | ❌ No |
| **Kernel schedule** | KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecializedMxf8f6f4Acc2x4Sm120 | KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecializedNvf4Sm120 | KernelSparseTmaWarpSpecialized2SmNvf4Sm100 |
| **Cluster shape** | 1×1×1 | 1×1×1 | 2×1×1 (2 SMs) |
| **Epilogue** | Standard LinearCombination | LinCombBlockScaleFactor (SFD output) | Standard (no SFD) |
| **Best for inference?** | ✅ BF16 output, no SFD overhead | ⚠ Extra SFD epilogue cost | ✅ Similar to 80a, but sm_100 target |
| **RTX 50 optimized?** | ✅ GeForce RTX 50 (sm_120) | ✅ GeForce RTX 50 (sm_120) | ❌ sm_100 (Blackwell Data Center) |

**For MiniCPM-SALA production inference (RTX 6000D? or RTX 50?):**
- If RTX 6000D (sm_120) → **80a** (lower epilogue cost, BF16 matches attention)
- If RTX 5000 Ada (sm_89) → Use dense CUTLASS (no sparse example; sparse broken for <sm_100)
- If Blackwell Data Center → **84a** (2-SM cluster, TMEM efficient)

---

### **Metadata E Byte Size Formula**

For M×K NVFP4 2:4 sparse matrix (target structure):
```
M_aligned = ceil(M / 128) × 128
K_aligned = ceil(K / 128) × 128
E_bytes = M_aligned × (K_aligned / 8)  (uint8_t elements)
        ≈ M × K / 8  (for typical large M, K >> 128)
```

**Example: 4096×32768 gate_up layer (MiniCPM-SALA)**
- M_aligned = 4096, K_aligned = 32768
- E_bytes = 4096 × 32768/8 = 16 MB (metadata, negligible vs 64 MB dense)

---

### **Key Decision Point: SFA Layout with Compression**

Compressor kernel does **not** touch SFA/SFB scale factors—they're orthogonal tensors managed by the mainloop collective. When A gets compressed from K→K/2 elements, SFA remains full resolution along the K dimension (not halved). This keeps per-block scale factors precise and avoids re-quantization.

---

All paths use CUTLASS's unified `StructuredSparseCompressor` (selecting SM90 kernel backend even for SM120), which guarantees correctness across architectures. No custom metadata extraction needed—just call `compressor_op.run()` and read `block_E`.

| (4608, 4096, 8192) | std_qkv M=8192 | Attention QKV，CUTLASS 更优 |

**优先级设计**（dispatch 树优先级）：

优先级 3: b12x b12x CUTLASS_OVERRIDE ∉ (shape, M_bucket) → b12x  (中等 batch)

> **替换任何 .so 必须先备份 + 写日志**：备份目录 `outputs/so_backups/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>__<src-name>__<sha256前12>/`，同时在 `docs/gemm/so-replacements.md` 追加替换日志。

#### 流程：

如果新加 sparse NVFP4 GEMM op（e.g. `sparse_fp4_gemm`）：

1. **编译**：`rebuild common_ops.abi3.so`（或单独 `.so`）
2. **备份**（prepare_env.sh G1 步前）：
   ```bash
   mkdir -p outputs/so_backups/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)__common_ops__<sha256>
   cp <old>.so <backup>/common_ops.abi3.so.orig
   echo "{...meta...}" > <backup>/meta.json
   ```
3. **替换**：`cp <new>.so $VENV_SP/sgl_kernel/...`
4. **日志**：在 `docs/gemm/so-replacements.md` 追加
5. **verify**：Stage 4 验证脚本检查符号、ABI 兼容性

---

### 7. **weight loading hook：sparse metadata 提取**

**当前 process_weights_after_loading() 流程**（line 1369-1520）：

#### 拟扩展位置（sparse metadata extraction）：

在 line 1458 后（Hybrid Marlin prep 前）插入：

```python
if layer._is_sparse_layer:  # 由 config sparse_layers 标记
    # 检测并提取 2:4 sparse pattern
    w = layer.weight.data  # (N, K/2) uint8
    
    # Unpack NVFP4：每字节 2 个 fp4 元素
    w_unpacked = unpack_nvfp4(w)  # (N, K) fp4 或 float16
    
    # 检测 2:4 sparsity（应该已满足）
    sparse_metadata = extract_2to4_metadata(w_unpacked)  # (N, K//4) uint8
    
    # 存储为 buffer（不参与反向）
    layer.register_buffer("sparse_metadata", 
                         torch.tensor(sparse_metadata, dtype=torch.uint8))
    layer._sparse_tile_k = K // 128  # 用于 sparse GEMM tiling
```

#### 在 apply() 中读取（line 1682 后，CUTLASS 前）：

```python
if getattr(layer, "_is_sparse_layer", False):
    # 调用 CUTLASS sparse GEMM kernel
    out = sparse_fp4_gemm(
        x_fp4, layer.weight,  # unpacked or kept packed
        x_sf, layer.weight_scale_interleaved,
        layer.sparse_metadata,
        layer.alpha, output_dtype,
    )
    if bias: out = out + bias
    return out.view(*output_shape)
```

### 结论

**MiniCPM-SALA 32 layer sparse 路径集成清单**：

1. ✅ **Dense 路径现状**：87 MLP Linear 走 CUTLASS sparse NVFP4，169 层（attn+fallback MLP）走 Marlin/b12x/CUTLASS hybrid
2. ✅ **dispatch 入口**：modelopt_quant.py ModelOptFp4LinearMethod.apply()
3. ✅ **sparse 标记**：config.json 新增 `sparse_layers` → layer._is_sparse_layer
4. ✅ **权重准备**：process_weights_after_loading() 调用 extract_2to4_metadata() 存 buffer
5. ✅ **dispatch 优先级**：在 apply() CUTLASS fallback 前检查 `_is_sparse_layer`，转向 sparse GEMM kernel
6. ✅ **.so 管理**：prepare_env.sh Stage 3 前备份，docs/gemm/so-replacements.md 记日志

24	class SparseGPTModifier(SparsityModifierBase):
25	    """
26	    Modifier for applying the one-shot SparseGPT algorithm to a model
27	
28	    Sample yaml:
29	
30	    ```yaml
31	    test_stage:
32	      obcq_modifiers:
33	        SparseGPTModifier:
34	          sparsity: 0.5
35	          mask_structure: "2:4"
36	          dampening_frac: 0.001
37	          block_size: 128
38	          targets: ['Linear']
39	          ignore: ['re:.*lm_head']
40	    ```
41	
42	    Lifecycle:
43	
44	    - on_initialize
45	        - register_hook(module, calibrate_module, "forward")
46	    - on_sequential_batch_end
47	        - sparsify_weight
48	    - on_finalize
49	        - remove_hooks()
50	
51	    :param sparsity: Sparsity to compress model to
52	    :param sparsity_profile: Can be set to 'owl' to use Outlier Weighed
53	        Layerwise Sparsity (OWL), more information can be found
54	        in the paper https://arxiv.org/pdf/2310.05175
55	    :param mask_structure: String to define the structure of the mask to apply.
56	        Must be of the form N:M where N, M are integers that define a custom block
57	        shape. Defaults to 0:0 which represents an unstructured mask.
58	    :param owl_m: Number of outliers to use for OWL
59	    :param owl_lmbda: Lambda value to use for OWL
60	    :param block_size: Used to determine number of columns to compress in one pass
61	    :param dampening_frac: Amount of dampening to apply to H, as a fraction of the
62	        diagonal norm
63	    :param preserve_sparsity_mask: Whether or not to preserve the sparsity mask
64	        during when applying sparsegpt, this becomes useful when starting from a
65	        previously pruned model, defaults to False.
66	    :param offload_hessians: Set to True for decreased memory usage but increased
67	        runtime.
68	    :param sequential_targets: list of layer names to compress
69	        during SparseGPT, or '__ALL__' to compress every layer
70	        in the model. Alias for `targets`
71	    :param targets: list of layer names to compress during SparseGPT, or '__ALL__'
72	        to compress every layer in the model. Alias for `sequential_targets`
73	    :param ignore: optional list of module class names or submodule names to not
74	        quantize even if they match a target. Defaults to empty list.
75	    """
76	
77	    # modifier arguments
78	    block_size: int = 128
79	    dampening_frac: float | None = 0.01
80	    preserve_sparsity_mask: bool = False
81	    offload_hessians: bool = False
82	
83	    # private variables
84	    _num_samples: dict[torch.nn.Module, int] = PrivateAttr(default_factory=dict)
85	    _hessians: dict[torch.nn.Module, torch.Tensor] = PrivateAttr(default_factory=dict)
86	
87	    def calibrate_module(
88	        self,
89	        module: torch.nn.Module,
90	        args: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
91	        _output: torch.Tensor,
92	    ):
93	        """
94	        Calibration hook used to accumulate the hessian of the input to the module
95	
96	        :param module: module being calibrated
97	        :param args: inputs to the module, the first element of which is the
98	            canonical input
99	        :param _output: uncompressed module output, unused
100	        """
101	        # Assume that the first argument is the input
102	        inp = args[0]
103	
104	        # Initialize hessian if not present
105	        if module not in self._num_samples:
106	            device = get_execution_device(module)
107	            self._hessians[module] = make_empty_hessian(module, device=device)
108	            self._num_samples[module] = 0
109	
110	        # Accumulate hessian with input with optional offloading
111	        with self._maybe_onload_hessian(module):
112	            self._hessians[module], self._num_samples[module] = accumulate_hessian(
113	                inp,
114	                module,
115	                self._hessians[module],
116	                self._num_samples[module],
117	            )
118	
119	    def compress_modules(self):
120	        """
121	        Sparsify modules which have been calibrated
122	        """
123	        for module in list(self._num_samples.keys()):
124	            name = self._module_names[module]
125	            sparsity = self._module_sparsities[module]
126	            num_samples = self._num_samples[module]
127	
128	            logger.info(f"Sparsifying {name} using {num_samples} samples")
129	            with (
130	                torch.no_grad(),
131	                align_module_device(module),
132	                CompressionLogger(module) as comp_logger,
133	            ):
134	                loss, sparsified_weight = sparsify_weight(
135	                    module=module,
136	                    hessians_dict=self._hessians,
137	                    sparsity=sparsity,
138	                    prune_n=self._prune_n,
139	                    prune_m=self._prune_m,
140	                    block_size=self.block_size,
141	                    dampening_frac=self.dampening_frac,
142	                    preserve_sparsity_mask=self.preserve_sparsity_mask,
143	                )
144	                comp_logger.set_loss(loss)
145	
146	            update_offload_parameter(module, "weight", sparsified_weight)
147	
148	            # self._hessians[module] already deleted by sparsify_weight
149	            del self._num_samples[module]
150	
151	    @contextlib.contextmanager
152	    def _maybe_onload_hessian(self, module: torch.nn.Module):
153	        if self.offload_hessians:
154	            device = get_execution_device(module)
155	            self._hessians[module] = self._hessians[module].to(device=device)
156	
157	        yield
158	
159	        if self.offload_hessians:
160	            if module in self._hessians:  # may have been deleted in context
161	                self._hessians[module] = self._hessians[module].to(device="cpu")
162	
163	    def on_finalize(self, state: State, **kwargs) -> bool:
164	        # TODO: modify lifecycle to end on finalize
165	        if not self.ended_:
166	            self.on_end(state, None)  # remove hooks
167	
168	        if len(self._num_samples) > 0:
169	            raise ValueError(f"Failed to compress {len(self._num_samples)} modules")
170	
171	        self._hessians = dict()
172	        self._num_samples = dict()
173	        self._module_names = dict()
174	        self._module_sparsities = dict()
175	
176	        return True
177

106	    def on_initialize(self, state: "State", **kwargs) -> bool:
107	        """
108	        Initialize and run the SparseGPT algorithm on the current state
109	
110	        :param state: session state storing input model and calibration data
111	        """
112	        model: torch.nn.Module = state.model
113	        dataloader: torch.utils.data.DataLoader = state.data.calib
114	
115	        # infer module and sequential targets
116	        # Note: only pass sequential_targets from kwargs, not the full kwargs dict
117	        # which may contain 'model' and cause duplicate argument errors
118	        self.sequential_targets = self._infer_sequential_targets(
119	            model, sequential_targets=kwargs.get("sequential_targets")
120	        )
121	        layers = get_layers(self.sequential_targets, model)
122	        self._target_layers = get_layers(
123	            self.targets, model
124	        )  # layers containing targets
125	
126	        # infer layer sparsities
127	        if self.sparsity_profile == "owl":
128	            logger.info(
129	                "Using OWL to infer target layer-wise sparsities from "
130	                f"{len(dataloader) if dataloader else 0} calibration samples..."
131	            )
132	            self.sparsity = self._infer_owl_layer_sparsity(model, layers, dataloader)
133	
134	        # get layers and validate sparsity
135	        if isinstance(self.sparsity, (list, dict)) and len(self._target_layers) != len(
136	            self.sparsity
137	        ):
138	            raise ValueError(
139	                f"{self.__repr_name__} was initialized with {len(self.sparsity)} "
140	                f"sparsities values, but model has {len(layers)} target layers"
141	            )
142	
143	        return True
144	
145	    def on_start(self, state: State, event: Event, **kwargs):
146	        self.started_ = True
147	
148	        # register hooks
149	        for index, (layer_name, layer) in enumerate(self._target_layers.items()):
150	            match self.sparsity:
151	                case dict():
152	                    layer_sparsity = self.sparsity[layer_name]
153	                case list():
154	                    layer_sparsity = self.sparsity[index]
155	                case _:
156	                    layer_sparsity = self.sparsity
157	
158	            for name, module in get_prunable_layers(layer).items():
159	                name = f"{layer_name}.{name}"
160	
161	                if match_targets(name, self.ignore)[0]:
162	                    continue
163	
164	                # HACK: previously, embeddings were not quantized because they were not
165	                # accessible by the layer compressor. For now, we manually ignore it,
166	                # but in the FUTURE this should be ignored by the user
167	                if isinstance(module, torch.nn.Embedding):
168	                    continue
169	
170	                if name.endswith("lm_head"):
171	                    logger.warning(
172	                        "`lm_head` was previously auto-ignored by SparseGPT and Wanda "
173	                        "modifiers and is not advised. Please add `re:.*lm_head` to "
174	                        "your ignore list if this was unintentional"
175	                    )
176	
177	                self._module_names[module] = name
178	                self._module_sparsities[module] = layer_sparsity
179	                self.register_hook(module, self.calibrate_module, "forward")
180	
181	    def on_event(self, state: State, event: Event, **kwargs):
182	        if event.type_ == EventType.CALIBRATION_EPOCH_START:
183	            if not self.started_:
184	                self.on_start(state, None)
185	
186	        if event.type_ == EventType.SEQUENTIAL_EPOCH_END:
187	            self.compress_modules()
188	
189	        if event.type_ == EventType.CALIBRATION_EPOCH_END:
190	            self.compress_modules()
191	
192	            if not self.ended_:
193	                self.on_end(state, None)
194	
195	    def on_end(self, state: State, event: Event, **kwargs):
196	        self.ended_ = True
197	        self.remove_hooks()
198	
199	    def _infer_sequential_targets(
200	        self, model: torch.nn.Module, **kwargs
201	    ) -> str | list[str]:
202	        targets_from_kwargs = kwargs.get("sequential_targets")
203	
204	        # Validate that sequential_targets is not provided from both sources
205	        if self.sequential_targets is not None and targets_from_kwargs is not None:
206	            raise ValueError(
207	                "sequential_targets was provided both in the modifier config and in "
208	                "oneshot() dataset_args. Please provide sequential_targets in only "
209	                "one location to avoid conflicts."
210	            )
211	
212	        match self.sequential_targets:
213	            case None:
214	                # Check if sequential_targets was passed via kwargs (from dataset_args)
215	                if targets_from_kwargs is not None:
216	                    if isinstance(targets_from_kwargs, str):
217	                        return [targets_from_kwargs]
218	                    return targets_from_kwargs
219	                # Fall back to auto-inference
220	                return get_no_split_params(model)
221	            case str():
222	                return [self.sequential_targets]
223	            case _:
224	                return self.sequential_targets
225	
226	    def _infer_owl_layer_sparsity(
227	        self,
228	        model: torch.nn.Module,
229	        layers: dict[str, torch.nn.Module],
230	        dataloader: torch.utils.data.DataLoader,
231	    ) -> dict[str, float]:
232	        activations = self._get_activations(model, dataloader)
233	
234	        groups = {}
235	        for name, layer in layers.items():
236	            prunable_layers = get_prunable_layers(layer)
237	            z = [
238	                m.weight.abs() * activations[f"{name}.{n}"].unsqueeze(0)
239	                for n, m in prunable_layers.items()
240	            ]
241	            groups[name] = torch.cat([item.flatten().cpu() for item in z])
242	
243	        del activations
244	
245	        outlier_ratios = {}
246	        for group in groups:
247	            threshold = torch.mean(groups[group]) * self.owl_m
248	            outlier_ratios[group] = (
249	                100 * (groups[group] > threshold).sum().item() / groups[group].numel()
250	            )
251	        outlier_ratios_arr = numpy.array([outlier_ratios[k] for k in outlier_ratios])
252	        for k in outlier_ratios:
253	            outlier_ratios[k] = (outlier_ratios[k] - outlier_ratios_arr.min()) * (
254	                1
255	                / (outlier_ratios_arr.max() - outlier_ratios_arr.min())
256	                * self.owl_lmbda
257	                * 2
258	            )
259	        outlier_ratios_arr = numpy.array([outlier_ratios[k] for k in outlier_ratios])
260	        sparsities = {
261	            k: 1
262	            - (
263	                outlier_ratios[k]
264	                - numpy.mean(outlier_ratios_arr)
265	                + (1 - float(self.sparsity))
266	            )
267	            for k in outlier_ratios
268	        }
269	        logger.info(f"OWL sparsities for sp={self.sparsity} are:")
270	        for k in sparsities:
271	            logger.info(f"Sparsity for {k}: {sparsities[k]}")
272	        return sparsities
273	
274	    def _get_activations(self, model, dataloader, nsamples=128) -> dict[str, int]:
275	        from llmcompressor.pipelines.basic import run_calibration
276	
277	        acts = defaultdict(int)
278	
279	        def save_acts(_module, input: tuple[Any, ...] | torch.Tensor, name: str):
280	            nonlocal acts
281	            if isinstance(input, tuple):
282	                input = input[0]
283	            acts[name] += 1.0 / nsamples * input.pow(2).sum(dim=(0, 1)).sqrt()
284	
285	        hooks = set(
286	            self.register_hook(mod, partial(save_acts, name=name), "forward_pre")
287	            for name, mod in model.named_modules()
288	            if isinstance(mod, torch.nn.Linear) and "lm_head" not in name
289	        )
290	        with HooksMixin.disable_hooks(keep=hooks):
291	            run_calibration(model, dataloader)
292	        self.remove_hooks(hooks)
293	
294	        return acts
295	
296	    def _split_mask_structure(self, mask_structure: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
297	        n, m = mask_structure.split(":")
298	        return int(n), int(m)
299

20	def accumulate_hessian(
21	    inp: torch.Tensor,
22	    module: torch.nn.Module,
23	    H: torch.Tensor,
24	    num_samples: int,
25	) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, int]:
26	    inp = inp.to(device=H.device)
27	    if len(inp.shape) == 2:
28	        inp = inp.unsqueeze(0)
29	
30	    num_added = inp.shape[0]  # note this is the number of dataset samples, not
31	    # multiplied by the sequence length
32	
33	    if isinstance(module, (torch.nn.Linear, transformers.Conv1D)):
34	        if len(inp.shape) == 3:
35	            inp = inp.reshape((-1, inp.shape[-1]))
36	        inp = inp.t()
37	
38	    if isinstance(module, torch.nn.Conv2d):
39	        unfold = torch.nn.Unfold(
40	            module.kernel_size,
41	            dilation=module.dilation,
42	            padding=module.padding,
43	            stride=module.stride,
44	        )
45	        inp = unfold(inp)
46	        inp = inp.permute([1, 0, 2])
47	        inp = inp.flatten(1)
48	
49	    H *= num_samples / (num_samples + num_added)
50	    num_samples += num_added
51	
52	    inp = inp.to(dtype=SGPT_PRECISION)
53	    inp = math.sqrt(2 / num_samples) * inp
54	    H += inp.matmul(inp.t())
55	
56	    return H, num_samples

59	def sparsify_weight(
60	    module: torch.nn.Module,
61	    hessians_dict: Dict[torch.nn.Module, torch.Tensor],
62	    sparsity: float,
63	    prune_n: int,
64	    prune_m: int,
65	    block_size: int,
66	    dampening_frac: float,
67	    preserve_sparsity_mask: bool,
68	) -> torch.Tensor:
69	    """
70	    Run pruning on the layer up to the target sparsity value.
71	
72	    :param module: module with weight being sparsified
73	    :param hessian_dict: dictionary containing preaccumulated hessian for sparsification
74	    :param sparsity: target sparsity to reach for layer
75	    :param prune_n: N for N:M pruning
76	    :param prune_m: M for N:M pruning
77	    :param block_size: Number of columns to compress in one pass
78	    :param dampening_frac: Amount of dampening to apply to H, as a fraction of the
79	        diagonal norm
80	    :param preserve_sparsity_mask: Extend or ignore the base sparsity mask
81	    """
82	    final_shape = module.weight.shape
83	    final_dtype = module.weight.dtype
84	    W = module.weight.clone()
85	    H = hessians_dict[module]  # unfortunately python does not have a `move` keyword
86	    del hessians_dict[module]  # so we have to delete the original reference manually
87	
88	    # standardize shape and dtype
89	    if isinstance(module, torch.nn.Conv2d):
90	        W = W.flatten(1)
91	    elif isinstance(module, transformers.Conv1D):
92	        W.transpose_(0, 1)
93	    W = W.to(dtype=SGPT_PRECISION)
94	    num_rows = W.shape[0]
95	    num_columns = W.shape[1]
96	
97	    # mask dead hessian values
98	    dead = torch.diag(H) == 0
99	    H[dead, dead] = 1
100	    W[:, dead] = 0
101	
102	    # compute inverse hessian in place to save memory
103	    try:
104	        damp = dampening_frac * torch.mean(torch.diag(H))
105	        diag = torch.arange(H.shape[0], device=H.device)
106	        H[diag, diag] += damp
107	        H = torch.linalg.cholesky(H)
108	        H = torch.cholesky_inverse(H)
109	        H = torch.linalg.cholesky(H, upper=True)
110	        Hinv = H
111	    except torch._C._LinAlgError:
112	        logger.warning(
113	            "Failed to invert hessian due to numerical instability. Consider "
114	            "increasing SparseGPTModifier.dampening_frac, increasing the number "
115	            "of calibration samples, or shuffling the calibration dataset"
116	        )
117	        Hinv = H = torch.eye(num_columns, dtype=H.dtype, device=H.device)
118	
119	    # sparsity mask
120	    # TODO: consider computing sparsity mask in the same way and place as gptq
121	    mask = None
122	    if preserve_sparsity_mask:
123	        # compute existing sparsity mask
124	        mask = torch.where(
125	            W == 0,
126	            torch.tensor(1, dtype=torch.bool),
127	            torch.tensor(0, dtype=torch.bool),
128	        )
129	        current_sparsity = mask.sum() / W.numel()
130	        if current_sparsity > sparsity:
131	            raise ValueError(
132	                "The target sparsity is lower than the sparsity "
133	                "of the base model. Please retry "
134	                "after turning preserve_sparsity_mask=False"
135	            )
136	
137	    losses = torch.zeros(num_rows, device=module.weight.device)
138	
139	    # See section 3.4 of https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.07259
140	    for i1 in range(0, num_columns, block_size):
141	        i2 = min(i1 + block_size, num_columns)
142	        count = i2 - i1
143	
144	        W1 = W[:, i1:i2].clone()
145	        Q1 = torch.zeros_like(W1)
146	        Err1 = torch.zeros_like(W1)
147	        Losses1 = torch.zeros_like(W1)
148	        Hinv1 = Hinv[i1:i2, i1:i2]
149	
150	        if prune_n == 0:
151	            if mask is not None:
152	                mask1 = mask[:, i1:i2]
153	                if int(W1.numel() * sparsity) > mask1.sum():
154	                    # target sparsity is higher than base sparsity, extend mask1
155	                    tmp = (
156	                        (~mask[:, i1:i2])
157	                        * W1**2
158	                        / (torch.diag(Hinv1).reshape((1, -1))) ** 2
159	                    )
160	                    thresh = torch.sort(tmp.flatten())[0][int(tmp.numel() * sparsity)]
161	                    mask1 = tmp <= thresh
162	            else:
163	                tmp = W1**2 / (torch.diag(Hinv1).reshape((1, -1))) ** 2
164	                thresh = torch.sort(tmp.flatten())[0][int(tmp.numel() * sparsity)]
165	                mask1 = tmp <= thresh
166	        else:
167	            if mask is not None:
168	                mask1 = mask[:, i1:i2]
169	            else:
170	                mask1 = torch.zeros_like(W1) == 1
171	
172	        for i in range(count):
173	            w = W1[:, i]
174	            d = Hinv1[i, i]
175	
176	            if prune_n != 0 and i % prune_m == 0:
177	                tmp = (
178	                    W1[:, i : (i + prune_m)] ** 2
179	                    / (torch.diag(Hinv1)[i : (i + prune_m)].reshape((1, -1))) ** 2
180	                )
181	                if mask is not None:
182	                    tmp = tmp * (~mask[:, i : (i + prune_m)])
183	
184	                mask1.scatter_(
185	                    1, i + torch.topk(tmp, prune_n, dim=1, largest=False)[1], True
186	                )
187	
188	            q = w.clone()
189	            q[mask1[:, i]] = 0
190	
191	            Q1[:, i] = q
192	            Losses1[:, i] = (w - q) ** 2 / d**2
193	
194	            err1 = (w - q) / d
195	            W1[:, i:] -= err1.unsqueeze(1).matmul(Hinv1[i, i:].unsqueeze(0))
196	            Err1[:, i] = err1
197	
198	        W[:, i1:i2] = Q1
199	        losses += torch.sum(Losses1, 1) / 2
200	
201	        if preserve_sparsity_mask:
202	            # respect the sparsity of other groups
203	            # really not needed, but kept for explicitness
204	            W[:, i2:] -= (~mask[:, i2:]) * Err1.matmul(Hinv[i1:i2, i2:])
205	        else:
206	            W[:, i2:] -= Err1.matmul(Hinv[i1:i2, i2:])
207	
208	    if isinstance(module, transformers.Conv1D):
209	        W.transpose_(0, 1)
210	    W = W.reshape(final_shape).to(final_dtype)
211	
212	    loss = torch.sum(losses).item()
213	    return loss, W
